tei:div.tei:p: kyang med/

hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu dgu la khrid gtor byas/ thog mar dge ba'i khrid ngo sprod dang bcas pa rgyas par bshad/ khrid gtor gyi skabs bzo bo'i rgyab la yod pa'i smon 'gro ba'i nang bzan 'ga' res drag chas sprad pa'i 'khrug pa slong pa'i rtsis 'dra byas na'ang*/ kha rog bsdad pas zar zir med tsam byung*/ 'di skabs rje drung rin po che'i sku gdung yang chos grwar bzhugs pa gling gi rdo sper spyan 'dren byas/ de nas smon 'gror gdan drangs/ de la kyal ka mang po byung ba'i lo rgyus yod/ gser 'bum yang gzungs bzhugs sogs med pa'i stong par bzhagarten khog stong bzhengs pa'i rten 'brel gyis smon 'gro ba rang la mi shis pa brgyud mar byung*/ de nas hor zla gnyis pa'i 'gol lung nag shel dkar brgyud lhun rtser phyin zla phyed skor zhig bsdad/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma sogs dbang bka' rjes gnang rnam grangs mang ba tsam byas/ dpon rigs so so'i 'dod chos than thun zhu bar yang mang bar byung*/ sde pa sku mched la mgon po'i rjes gnang zhig phul ba shin tu zil che ba'i thugs kyi snang ba cher 'gyur ba zhig byung*/ de skabs byin rlabs yin khungs byas te/ yin ni 'tshub ka yin par 'dugargyal bu na phra mo la tshe dbang sogs mang po phul/ sde pa sku bgres pa'i drung dang yon mchod lhan du khrod phu'i gnas rnams mjal/ 'ja' sprin ya mtshan can mang po byung zhing*/ byams chen la gsol ba btab pas me tog gi char yang rdzun med du babs/ sang nyin o rgyan rdzong du slob dpon sa'i drung gi dgongs bzhed ltar tshe dbang brgya tshar dang nai gu bsdus pa zhig phul/ bsam 'grub rtse nas 'byor rgyas pa 'bod mir gnang byung ba bzhin bsam rtser sleb pa'i nyin khyud rtse phyag tu 'byor pa'i spyan 'dren pa rnams sleb pa'i thugs brel gda'/ dgongs bzhed ltar zhal ngo thams cad la tshe dbang brgya rtsa phul/

kun spangs drung snga sor 'brug sbrul rta gsum lug gi stong tshun gyes dgyes mdzad pa zhig yod kyang*/ bar der smon 'gro nas rgyug rag btang*/ rje btsun kun dga' mchog grub kyi 'bral spang bde dgyes legs legs mo rgya gar ma'i khungs gnyis dang po chos lung byang rtse'i rten gral na yod pa brkus nas smos 'gror yod pa de tsho dang*/ nor sna bzang la mang ba kun spangs drung la phul/ rdzi lung zhi ba'i zhor la zhu log mang po bcug 'dug pas/ kun spangs pa thugs 'gyur ba zhig 'duganged kyi bsam pa la ni e e bsam pa las ma byung*/ sku 'bring bas zhag bcu skor sdod gsung ba ltar bsdad/ rgyal rtse bla ma'i drung la dgongs bzhed kyi bka' chos 'dra phul/ zur rba khang slob dpon pa chos rje bsod nams dar rgyas ched btang nged 'phrad pa la phebs/ sngar phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po'i gdams pa zhig khong la bshad pa de la nyams len mdzad pa'i gsal snang 'dra shar 'dugakhong da res min pa mi 'phrad gsung gin 'dug pa de kha bzhin byung*/ byang chen du smyung gnas dang sgrub sde rnams la ma hā mā ya'i dbang bskur dang 'khrid tshul than thun 'dra bshad/ dang po bsnyen rdzogs byas pa nas 'di yan chad du gsang 'dus 'phags zhabs lugs gnyis kyi gzhung bzang la mang ba rnams dang*/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/ gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs sogs dang*/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/ sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang*/ rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang*/ grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drugayid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang*/ 'phreng ba skor gsum sogs dang*/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang*/ bslab btus dang byang sa la sogs gzhung chen mang po la yang 'dris par sbyangs pas rang re'i thos bsam dag dpe lta kho na la brten pa'i blo gros kyi lus phal cher rdzogs song*/

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha'i byin rlabs dang nyams myong rgyu mtshan du byas pa'i legs bshad dang nges gsang gi blo gros ni phyis rgyal ba rang shin tu mang bar yod do/ / de skabs slob dpon rin po che'i drung cung zad sku khams bsnyel ba zhig byung*/ bsam sdings su phebs bzhed che bar 'dug pas chas de phar lam tshong 'dus su rab gnas shig byas pa bkra mi legs pa rang byung*/ de 'phral bsam gtan sdings su phebs/ de mtshams nas sku khams je long du song sman dpyad kun yang cung zad log pa'i zla ba gnyis tsam gyi bar du shin tu nyen pa byung*/ sleb 'phral nas mtshams dam par bcad/ dgongs re bzhin sku rim du dmigs pa'i drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa gtor ma'i cho ga rnam grangs mang tsam btang de min dge sbyor rang la 'bungs bskyed/ tho rangs snga mo nas sngon 'gro gtor ma sngon du 'gro ba'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rim nyin thun bzhi po gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar 'dor len du bsgrubs shing*/ bzlas brjod la shin tu 'grus par byas/ srod thun la lag mchod dang*/ phyi rol mchod pa rgyas pa re gtor ma'i sngon du ma chag pa dang*/ nang phyed du nye ba na bum pa can gyi rlung sbyor dang*/ dpyid thig bsgom pas 'da' bar byas/ zla ba phyed gnyis tsam gyi mtshams su tshong 'dus nas sde pa lhun chen sku gshegs pa'i stabs dgongs rdzogs kyi snying po dang*/ mtshan byang bzhu ba la 'gro dgos kyis mtshams seng pa dang 'gro ba mnyam du byas shing dbu rtser zhag gcig sdod dgos byung*/ sang dgongs ka mtshams bsdams/ slar yang sngar gyi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la zhugs/ de'i snga gong lha'i gsal snang dang bde stong gi nyams mang po 'char ba zhig yod pa zla phyed tsam gyi bar du sor ma chud/ de nas drung 'tsho ba sa lung pas slob dpon rin po cher gsol sman sogs phul ba 'phrod rten gyi ngo che bar byung zhing*/

nged rang bad mkhris kyi zhag shas gyong nge ba na ba zhig la nad 'don gyi dmigs pa dang rlung sbyor 'phran bu byas pas snga gro zhig dud khu 'dra ba sla nga do tsam skyugs/ de gong bad mkhris mtho mo de lo shas bde bar byung*/ des na man ngag khungs ma'i gegs sel thams cad des mtshon par go dgos/ rim pa de nyid kyi hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga yan chod du dpal sdom pa lū dril nag gsum car gyi bsnyen pa yid rnam g.yengs kho na'i dbang du ma song tsam du grub/ gsum car gyi rdzogs rim la yang so sor myong ba cung zad thon/ yang 'di skabs nas tshigs grum la brten rkang pa shin tu na ba zhig rgyun chags rang du byung*/ zla ba de nyid kyi nyer gcig la rgya gar shar phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon ni rbā ṇa shrī yang phebs byung zla ba phyed gnyis tsam bzhugs shing*/ sngar grub chen lho phyogs pa la legs par mnos pa'i gdams pa dang bshad pa'i 'phro rnams la shin tu phan thogs che bar byung*/ 'di skabs zam brag nas sde pa ka bzhi'i drung gis rab gnas la yong dgos tshul gnang byung na'ang*/ slob dpon rin po che sku khams yid brtan thub pa mi 'dug pa dang dgongs pa'ang ma grol ba'i stabs nas 'gro ma thub/ des khong tsho dang sde pa kun spangs drung yang shin tu ma dgyes te thabs kyang ma byung mod/ nged la khyad kyang ma mchis la khong tsho la snying po yang ci yod/ phaṭa/ brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga man nas 'tshams ma grol gyi bar du rje btsun ma zhal gnyis ma la bsnyen pa byas shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags mtshan yang ci rigs pa byung*/ nyin mtshan du dge sbyor 'phel bar byas pa'i phan yon gyis gnyid kyi skabs su yang dran pas zin cing rtags snang mang po shin tu gsal bar 'char ba dang rmi lam mi zin pa mi srid pa lta bur song lha sku'i sbyong spel gyi rtsal shin tu che bar byung*/ lkog gyur yul snang than thun gtan la phebs pa dang rmi lam gyi dus thams cad du bzlas brjod kyi snang ba rgyun mi 'chad bar 'byung ba dang nyin par lha sku drag tu bsgoms pa'i shugs kyis mi rtog pa gsal stong la cham cham 'gro zhing*/

res 'ga' gzhan gyi sems shes pa snyam byed pa la so sor bsgrims te bltas pa'i tshe du bas gzugs bsgribs pa bzhin mun mun 'gro ba zhig byung*/ phyis bla ma dam pa la zhus pas gzhan sems shes pa snyam byed pa la ci dgar bskyur na yon tan gong 'phel du 'gro ba la ched 'dzin byas pa des bsgribs pa yin gsung*/ spyir nas dbang shes bde stong du gnas ma gyur gyi bar du dngos gnas ji lta ba bzhin du shes dka' zhing*/ nang gi rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi byed pa la brten te nyams kyi tshul du skye ba dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha lta bur snang ba ngo bo nyams snang du shar ba rnams kyis ci rigs pa ston pa yong bar snang ste dngos gnas yin pa dka'o/ / 'di skabs phyin chad nas dben par mtshams bcad de 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgom bzlas la zhugs pa'i tshe rmi lam du sa gsum gyi pho nya'i rnam pas khyab pa dang bde stong gi nyams gzhig par dka' ba rtag tu yod snang*/ 'on kyang phyis chos sna tshogs gzhan la smra dgos 'di dang*/ dam sel gyi grib mas non pas gong 'phel du 'gro ba ni med do/ / de nas slob dpon dam pa re zhig sku khams bde ba'i rnam pa byung*/ sngar sor nas so sos 'bod mi nan chags yod pa ltar hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du bsam sdings nas btegs khyung rtser zhag gcig bsdad/ de'i sang nyin yol mo sprul sku'i drung dang mjal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig dgos gsung pa ltar phul zhing*/ nged la shin tu thugs mos stobs su gyur pa'i zhabs dbang dgos phebs smon lam mang po 'debs pa gnang gin 'dugagasung las bdag tsho lus kyang bde mo mi 'dug pas gson gshin ji ltar byung yang thugs dam skyabs 'og tu 'jug dgos so gsung ngo*/ / 'dol byung du dbang chos rang mi rang las byas/ rje rgyud pa ba sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yang nged 'phrad par phebs byung*/ dgongs bzhed ltar rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi rjes gnang kyang phul/

sngags phyogs kyi gsung gleng shin tu 'phel ba byung*/ shin tu dgyes shing thugs dang ba dpe med mdzad kyin 'dugade nas stag rtser kun ra bas mthun rkyen bzang po sbyar/ de nas rgyal mkhar rtser zla gcig lhag tsam li ma lha khang gi mdo'i g.yabs khra der sdod yul byas/ rten bzang ba sogs kyis yin nam rig pa dwangs shing rmi lam bzang ba sha stag byung*/ rwa lo chen po'i thugs dam rten yin nges dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi thang sku de sngas 'gor bkram te srod tho rangs bzlas sgom dang gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas/ lan cig rang nyid 'jigs mdzad kyi sku nyang stod kyi lung pa de yang zhabs gcig gis khengs pa tsam gyi sku tshad shin tu che ba zhig tu gyur te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po mthong ba snyam byed pa zhig byung*/ bdag po chen pos snga sor sku la yang yang phan pa'i drin bsob tu 'bring mtshams dge grong phyed ka dang*/ mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i drung gis bsam sdings kyi sgrub sde gsar 'dzugs kyi thes su dpal be lha lung gi chos gzhis gnang*/ 'di skabs don gnyer so so la/ lam 'bras kyi gzhung bshad smar ma sogs kyi lung dang*/ grub chen dza landha ra ba'i do ha'i man ngag dang bshad pa/ de nyid bdud 'grel gyi bshad pa/ dmar po skor gsum gyi man ngag yongs rdzogs kyi lung*/ grub pa sde bdun dang*/ snying po skor drug gi lung*/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang cha gnyis bde mchog bong zhal can gyi dbang*/ thod pa nyer lnga ma'i dbang*/ gshed dmar gyi 'od gsal 'char ba'i byin rlabs/ nai gu chos drugadril bu rim lnga/ gshed dmar spros med sogs chos shin tu 'phel bar byung*/ bhaṅga la'i paṇḍi ta purṇānanda te gang ba kun dga' dang*/ pra ya mā nanda te byams pa kun dga' gnyis kyang byon byung ba nged kyis chos kyi gsung gleng mang du byas pas khong gnyis shin tu dgyes/

ngas kyang paṇḍi ta yin tshul rgya cher bsgrags/ khong tsho mar lam paṇḍi ta yin pa sus kyang ma shes/ khong rang tshos yin gsungs kyang rtsis gdab ma byas 'dug na'ang*/ phyis song dus de skabs ka paṇḍi ta yin par yang shes/ thugs dam 'di la byed ces sogs gnang chung de 'dra la yang cha med rgyus gtam gyi chos brgyad mdzad mkhan yang snang ngo*/ / mar lam rtse chen du zhag gsum bsdad/ chos sde'i slob dpon so sor 'dod chos than thun dang*/ rtse'i lha khang du logs bris zhig gsos dang gsung rab rnams la rab gnas rgyas pa zhig kyang byas/ slar bsam sdings su sleb/ de'i sang dgongs nyid nas mtshams bsdams/ bde mchog gi bsnyen pa kha gso zhag bdun pa zhig byas nas/ yab bka' yum bka' gnyis 'dus kyi sbyin bsreg zhag bcu gsum tsam byas shing grangs kyang thim/ de mtshams nas thab kyang kha bsgyur te sdig sgrib sbyang bar rang la dmigs rang gi skra bregs pa'i bubs sum cu tsam yod pa thams cad sbyin bsreg gi tshul du bsregs/ 'di skabs 'char sgo ngo mtshar che ba rang zhig byung*/ de rjes dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rdzogs bzlas pa'i thun che ba re 'chag med du byas shing*/ lhag ma gshin rje gshed dmar po'i bzlas brjod dang*/ srung ma'i dbang po 'ga' zhig gi bsnyen pa byas/ rgya gar nub phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon chen po purṇ+ṇa badzra ba dpon slob kyang phebs byung ba la yang 'phral zhabs 'degs gang drag byas chos kyi 'phros mang du zhus/ sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad nas bcu'i bar du 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod chen dngos grub 'byung gnas de nyin re la thun re bris pas legs par grub/ rang la blo brtad pa'i gshin po 'ga' zhig gi rjes sgrub dang dus mtshungs byung bas yan lag bdun pa'i smon lam rnams de dag la dmigs pa gtso che bas btab/ 'di'i tshes bcu'am dgu la yol mo sprul sku yang gshegs/

sngags kyi mngon par ming btags pa'i rtsom pa de yang byas/ 'phags yul mkhas grub kyi thugs bcud phyogs 'dir nged rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i legs bshad nges don gyi gsang tshig 'gos che ba brtsams pa'i thog ma yin/ de nas mi ring bar zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i sprul sku yang pa rnam du phebs/ de'i gnangs nyin sde pa ka bzhi'i drung yang bsam sdings su 'phrad pa la phebs/ rje zhwa dmar ba mjal bar phyin dus dpe med kyi bsti stang gnang*/ rdo rje'i bsung brgya lnga bcu pa'i lung zhig dang*/ sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid yig chos rje rang byung bas mdzad pa de'i lung dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor kun 'dus nor bu lugs shig dang*/ phyag chen lnga ldan gyi khrid yig bsdus pa rje dkon mchog yan lag gis mdzad pa'i lung zhig kyang thob/ de 'phral rgyal rtser dpon sa mnga' bdag drung gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi cho ga la yod dgos kyi 'bod mi byung bas/ de nub bsam sdings su sleb tsam byas/ sang snga bar shad nas phyin nas dgongs ja thog tu rgyal rtser sleb/

de nas dgongs rdzogs ma grol gyi bar spur gyi rtsar mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga tshar bzhi bzhi bdag mdun bum bskyed rnams la bzlas pa brgya tshar re dang thun tha ma la lho sgo 'chag med re byas/ dpon sa yul de nyid rje dam pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i gdung shugs gang dang yang mi mnyam pa dngos la'ang shin tu thugs brtad pa cig yin pa nas dgongs rdzogs la dmigs pa'i chos sder sman bla chen mo'i lugs kyi nyin thub kyi rnyed bkur zhig dang*/ dge 'dun rnams kyi phyag tu khal re thob pa'i rtsis kyi 'gyed dang*/ sman bla phyed langs kyi dbang du byas pa'i rnyed bkur dang 'gyed sogs btang zhing*/ dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi grol mtshams nyi phyed tsam la thon par byas te/ sang nyin bsam sdings su sleb par byas/ yol mo sprul sku rin po che gshegs khar zhal chems su dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i gral dbu nged la chos gsung ba yod 'dug pa ltar khong rnams kyis snga sor nas yong dgos tshul yod pa bzhin de'i sang nyin skyid sbug tu sleb/ phyi na gur rgyab 'dug pas de khar cho ga btang nyi ma phyed yol tsam la rnal 'byor pa shas che ba'i dgon sna mang po nas 'dus pa'i tshogs pa lnga brgya tsam la dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi bzab ma byung*/ gral 'go la nged kyis phyin/ sang nyin chos rje gdan sa pa sogs la shis brjod dang tshe dbang sogs byas nyi phyed tsam la yongs/ pa rnam zhol du gser mdog can nas mkhan slob tshos gnas tshang du gsol ja la shog gsung pa ltar phyin/ gsung rab kyi gling slang dang bzhad gad 'dres mas nyams dga' bar byung*/ de nub rang gnas su sleb zhag nyi shu skor phyi mtshams se byas shing*/ snga gong stag lung nas skyabs gnas dam pa'i bka' las/ 'phags yul nas byung ba'i chos gsar pa 'di rnams rgya gzhung kun lag tu longs dka' bar 'dug pas thams cad la yig cha gsal ba re byed dgos bka' stsal ba ltar 'phral du byed 'dod tsam yod na'ang le los rgyu byas brel ba dang kha 'don sogs kyi stabs nas cher ma grub/

yos lo'i nang du dran bskul gyi phyir sa bcad tsam re bris/ skabs 'dir dza landha ra'i sgrub thabs ltar gyi phag mo las bdun/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs rngon pa'i gdams ngagarnal 'byor ma sna tshogs mdog can rnams kyi sgrub skor dang*/ do ha rnam grol snye ma'i khrid yig sogs man ngag gi yi ge drug tsam bris shing*/ de nas mtshams bkros te tshor 'dus su sleb tsam byas dgongs bzhed kyi chos than thun phul/ sde pa rgyal bu sku bgres pa'i dgongs bzhed ltar phyag drug pa'i gtor chog snga ma de brtsams/ dza landha ra'i do ha'i ṭā+-i ka rtsom pa'i 'go yang btsugs shing*/ de nas snar thang du gtsug lag khang gi rten rnams la phyag mchod rgyas par phul/ 'di skabs skor du sde pa snar thang nas dang mthong legs pa khong rang dpon g.yog 'phrogs pa/ khong dpon g.yog gnyis thad nas/ nged la thugs rtog zos pa'i gsung 'byon pa zhig 'dugaspyi babs ni rang gis bzang ma btang ba'i gnod pa yang yin srid pa dang*/ khyad par lung bstan sad sud la thugs brtad rang 'cha' ba zhig 'dug pas de ltar yin nam cha ma mchis/ gang ltar na'ang thugs rab che shos dang thugs dran gsal shos dang thugs chod che shos dang lung bstan mdzad pa po rnams kyi rang 'tshang ston byed tsam du gda'o/ / gnas srin po rir shog gsung ba ltar zhag gsum tsam bsdad cing*/ dgongs bzhed ltar gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbang bskur zhig byas lung nag shel dkar du yang gnas bcu'i thang ka gsar bzhengs la rab gnas byas pa bkra lod pa rang zhig byung bas de rjes lo de ka'i nang du shel dkar gyi gdong de la 'gro dgos lan gnyis byung na'ang khong tshol gsangs nas phyin/ de nas jo nang du sleb gtsang bde mchog rtse la 'bod mi nan can byung ba bzhin phyin/ 'di skabs 'du khang gi logs bris skyes rabs brgya rtsa dang gtsang khang gi logs bris dang lam 'bras bla brgyud kyang gcig gnyis ma gtogs phal cher grub 'dug pa bzhin rab gnas rgyas par byas/

rten rnams snum zhing bkrag che bar 'gro ba sogs thun mong spyi mthun du byin rlabs kyi ltas mngon tsam byung*/ dgon pa ba rnams la kyai rdor gyi dbang bskur zhig dang*/ sngar lam 'bras zhu myong ba'i grwa pa 'ga' zhig la lam dbang zhig kyang byas/ slar jo nang du dus 'khor sgrub mchod kyi skabs su byung ba rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i steng de nyid nas sgrub sde gang yod kyi steng du rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis pa dpon slob sogs ci rigs dang bcas pa yongs sgril bdun brgya tsam la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bcu gcig yongs rdzogs su bskur/ dza landha ra pa'i do ha'i 'grel pa yang 'di skabs su bkod grub/ sangs rgyas byang chung sems dang rdo rje ma/ / skad cig de la nam mkha' gang bar snang*/ / zhes pa'i tshig gi 'grel pa rtsom skabs/ nyin mo gnyid yur du song ba'i rmi lam na gzhung don dang mthun pa'i rmi lam gyi ltas nam mkha'i lha las dbang bskur blang ba'i gsal snang dang bcas pa byung zhing*/ gdong dga' ba sku gzhon pa tshe brtan lags khong rang tsho la shin tu gces pa yin pa/ nged la'ang snying nas dad pa yod nges de ngam rings du 'das pa'i bsngo rten yang 'di skabs byung*/ slar yang de mtshams slob dpon rin po che'i drung du/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang la sogs pa chos 'ga' zhig zhu bar myur shad phyin/ bo dong bkra shis sgang gi thad der gdong dga' nas tshe dbang bskur ba la yong dgos tshul 'bod mi nan can dpe med rang byung na'ang da res yong mi thub/ zla ba gnyis tsam gyi khongs su yong gang thub byed byas thag bcad nas phyin/ byang chen du sleb dus paṇḍi ta purṇā nanda dang pra yā mā nanda gnyis po'ang lha sa sogs dbus phyogs rnams 'khor ba'i nged la ched kyis 'phrad par byon/ de dag grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bar 'dug cing phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/

rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos than thun 'dra bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srungs ma ha nu manda'i cho 'phrul lus byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang bha ra ta'i srungs ma rgyal po bhī ma dngos su mthong bas paṇḍi ta na re khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsung na'ang*/ chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pa ga la zhigaphyis kyi bla chen mang po'i 'dod bya chen po zhig de dus rang rtsol med du 'grub la khad byung na'ang rnal 'byor ba bdag gis ci dgar bor ba lags so/ / zhag bcu tsam nyid dang mtshan du gleng slang byung*/ de rjes bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa dang dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur ba zhus/ 'dol byung du khor tsam zhig phyin/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyang spyan drangs te/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang*/ gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/ dril bu lha lnga gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil la sogs pa'i dbang bskur mang pau zhus shing*/ de mtshams rgyal rtser zhag gsum tsam zhig phyin/ yar lam mar lam gnyis car tal snyogs byas/ bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi drung du slar yang lū hi pa dang*/ 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang de zhus/ de mtshams shangs nas 'jag pa rnams kyis 'bod mi nan can byung bar brten shangs su phyin dus gar phyin phyin du yul mi thams cad la tshe dbang dang ma ṇi'i lung tsam gyi chos 'brel byas/ rnam rgyal gling du zhag gsum tsam bsdad grwa tshang chen mor mang ja'i rgyur ja sigs gcig phul/

gzhan gnang sbyin dgos na bla chen 'ber mo tsho la zhus shig bya btang la rgyu nor gyi re ma che/ yar lam zhong zhong gi gnas mjal tsam byas te/ de nub sgrub gnas chen po 'jag tu sleb/ sang nyin grwa tshang chen mo'i slob dpon pa rin po che tshul khrims pa sogs shangs kyi dgon so so nas chos zhu ba mang bar sleb pa'i gnangs nyin de ka nas shangs chos rgyas pa'i 'go btsugs te/ phyi'i chos grwar khrid kyi chos thun gnyis gnyis mgon po'i bka' rnams ma gtogs gzhung bka' nyi shu po yang chos grwa de nyid du bgyis shing lung yang phal che ba de kar song*/ chos kyi rnam grangs gzhan thams cad bla brang du byas shing nam langs ma thag nas srod chil gyi bar du chos kyis 'da' bar byas/ gnas der rig pa dwangs po nyin mo'i bya bas dub pa'i rnam pa med pa'i nub mo kha 'don dge sbyor shin tu smar ba dang gnyid cung zad re byung ba la yang rmi lam ya mtshan can kho nas dus 'da' bar byung*/ tshogs pa rnams la tshe dbang zhig byas pa la ched kyis brda' btang ba sogs med kyang mda' nas mi nag pa stong bud tsam tshogs mi tshogs che zhing dad pa'ang che bar 'dug pas byang chub kyi sa bon thebs su re ba'i tshe dbang gi sngon du sems bskyed kyi cho ga rgyas pa zhig byas/ grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor gyi yin thang zhal phye ba'i dus su 'ja' sprin gyi bkod pa sna tshogs las me tog gi char 'bab pa byung*/ de mtshams dgra 'dul nas kyang 'bod mi nan can dang*/ brgya tsho nas kyang cog po rtse tsam du cis kyang yod dgos shing*/ zhal ngo rnams kyang cog po rtser phebs gsung ba sogs byung kyang*/ gdong dga' nas 'phral du yong dgos pa'i 'bod mi nan ches pa dang*/ de skabs gdong dga' ba'i gnas gshis kyis 'dod dang ma bstun kyang ma byung ba'i stabs nas de tshor 'gro ma thub cing cog po rtse grub chen khyung po'i gnas chen yin pa la mjal yang ma thub/

spyir yang yon bdag gi ngos 'dzin 'di bar chad shin tu che bar yong gin gda'o/ khong lam du zhag gnyis bsdad shin tu 'tshub pa rang zhig byung ba khong tsho'i nad so grag shos de lo 'das/ g.yang gi chos sder sde pa chos rje'i sras po sku 'bring ba smo smo drung dang bcas pas sna len bzang po dpe med mdzad cing*/ chos than thun 'dra phul/ de nas o rgyan rdzong du dpon sa'i drung gi dgongs bzhed bzhin smar khrid kyi snying po bsdus pa zhig dang tshe dbang sogs phul te/ ra sa brgyud nas gdong dgar sleb/ zhag bcu gsum tsam bsdad pa'i ring la kyai rdor gyi dbang sogs dbang dang dmar po skor gsum la sogs pa rjes gnang zur bka' mang po dang*/ yul gang du'ang mi bcu pa yar klungs su bcu'i rnam pas tshe dbang stong rtsa rang byed dgos byung*/ ri khrod chen po jo nang du sleb 'phral nas dus khrid sngar khyud kyi phyag len ltar btsugs/ de la'ang dus khrid 'dzugs 'phyis pas khrid gsar ba ha cang mang ba rang ni ma byung*/ sgrub ste rang la khrid shin tu smin pa bar du dge ba'i khrid yan chad rdzogs par byas shing nges don rgya mtsho bshad/ kun dga' dpal bzang yang 'di skabs zla bo la sleb pa yin/ skabs der 'tsher du mjal bar khor tsam phyin/ gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang zur bka' zhig zhus pas rdo rje 'phreng ba'i de ka byung*/ slar jo nang du chos lung byang rtse'i sgrub sde pa rnams chos zhu bar byung ba nyer mkho'i kyai rdo rje/ mi 'khrugs pa/ bde mchog nag po pa bde mchog lha lnga/ 'jigs byed rnams kyi dbang dang rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs sogs byas so/ / 'dir smas pa/ tha snyad ngan g.yo'i zlos gar de yis ci/ / nges don sbrang rtsi 'thung ba 'di nyid mchog/ dus ni mi brtan lang tsho yol pa dang*/ mi rtag don sems yang dag don la gzhol/ de mtshams rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa mjal bar 'dod pas bshul lam du zhugs te bde chen gdong dga' sogs brgyud nas bde skyid gling du sleb/

nyi shar du sde pa brtan pa lags yum sras gnyis car sman pas dpyad phul ba ma 'phrod pa'i stabs gcig tu gshegs pa nas/ sde pa rje drung kun dga' bsod nams drung gis nged la yong dgos tshul nan chags gnang ba la mi yong bar thag chod zhus na'ang*/ slar yang nan chags yod skabs rje drung la mnga' zhabs dang*/ chos sde yul log byas/ brag stod nas bla ma rin po ches/ yum sras sku gshegs pa gnyis kyi spur bzhu byang bzhu nang skabs kyi zhabs tog dang dgongs rdzogs dang yon sogs kyang nyi shar slob dpon ba dang*/ mi sna 'dus pas byed pa las/ rje drung rang la rang dbang thob pa gcig kyang med par ma zad dam 'jur che bar byas 'dugabla ma dam pa'i phyag dam na shel dkar phyogs la song na legs pa 'dug cing brag stod du rtse 'dzom tsam gnang phebs pa ltar phar lam chu tshan khar zhugs gsum tsam chu tshan cung zad bsten pas de skabs kyi de mgo srin dang chu ser la phan par byung*/ shel dkar du sleb dus der rdzong gzhis dang chos sde sogs phal cher gogs shing dengs pa'i rnam pa can du 'dug pa mthong ba'i rkyen gyis skyo shas drag tu skye ba byung*/ rtsibs ri rgod tshang mjal rje rgod kyi zhe bcad dang sgrub tshugs kyi rnam thar la 'jug par smon lam snying thag pa nas btab/ der bzhugs kyi dpon slob rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig chos 'brel du byas/ brag stod rdo rje'i pho brang du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du 'byor/ dpon slob rnams kyang de ka'i khar nyin ka phebs pa yin/ sku mthong ba'i mod la sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i rig pa rjen gyis song*/ mtshan zangs kyi phyi'i snang ba ban bun tsam la rig pa yer gyis thon pa bde sdug las 'das pa zhig byung*/ skabs 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa dang po'i 'char sgo sbyor rgyu yin/ 'di skabs bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du 'khrid tshul man ngag sgrub thabs sogs rnam grangs mang ba zhig don gnyer gyis zhus shing gnang*/

gsar du bsgyur ba'i dbang byin rlabs rnams dgos phebs pa ltar phul/ bka' stsal spyi bor nod de sgrub sde rnams la rtsa dbu ma'i khrid byin rlabs ngo sprod dang bcas pa dang*/ nag po pa'i bskyed rdzogs gyi khrid rnams zhib par bshad/ de mtshams spa lung du phyin zhag gnyis tsam bsdad/ spa lung chos rje ngag dbang pa dang lhan du lus kyi phu'i la la thon nas glang skor du sku gdung dkar ru dang dam pa'i sku 'dra mtshal zhal ma/ ko brag pa'i sku 'dra phyag gnas ma sogs rten mjal thams cad zhib par bgyis/ rten rnams la dkar me snyan dar sogs mchod pa bzang rab phul zhing*/ sku gdung dkar ru la mthong snang mang du byung*/ de nub rmi lam du grub thob bcu drug dang mkhas mchog bcu drug gi sku'i snang ba dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i ltas byung nas gsol 'debs kyang brtsams/ 'di byin rlabs sna bsdus 'jug tshul gcig yin pa 'dugarje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rang gis grub thob pho mo lnga bcu sogs mang po rang cig mjal 'dug pa de'i rten 'brel cig yin pa 'dra'o/

/ zhing rings su phyin yul pa de la gdon gyi bar chad kyi 'tshub chen po 'dugarig pa 'ur nas khrom mi thams cad brdungs gshis ngan pa'i grags pas khyab/ 'on kyang yul pa de tsho rang gi chags sgo sangs par mngon/ sa skya yul chung spe leb ra chu rnams su so so'i 'dod pa ltar yig drug dang tshe dbang gtso bor gyur pa'i chos 'brel thogs par byas/ slar yang spa lung du bde mchog gi dbang dang*/ nai gu'i dmigs 'doms dang*/ rjes gnang 'ga' shas dang khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la brag stod du sleb/ sprul sku sman thang pas ngam ring du snyan 'bul la brten te dpon sa mnga' bdag drung nas bka' tho nan can chos lung gi mi sna dang bcas pa 'bod mir 'byor/ zla ba 'di'i nang du drung chen grags pa la dus 'khor gyi dbang zhig byas pa sgrub sde pa thams cad kyis kyang gsan/ bla ma dam pas dgyes pa rdo rje la brten nas dam rdzas sgrub pa'i phyag g.yog de bgyis shing*/ 'di skabs kyang dri bzang thag ring du tshor ba dang rdzas la sgra dang bcas te khol ba ltar gyur pa la dngos su bdud rtsi babs pa'i rnam pa ya mtshan can byung*/ rjes gnang byin rlabs 'dra zhu yin yod pa'i skabs su/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas/ da dung sems khrid la bskyar ma zhig byas na mi legs sam phebs byung bas de ma thag blo dang snang ba 'gyur nas lus nyams rkyen gang gis kyang mi non pa 'dra ba dang*/ sems la ngos gzung med pa mchi ma rang dbang med par 'byung zhing*/ rgod pa la sogs pa'i ngag nyams sna tshogs shar/ de nub nyid kyang med cing gnam sa gang yin yang btang med du song*/ ngam ring la 'gro ba'i blo yang bzlogade mtshams rang bsam sdings nas slob dpon rin po che'i phyag dam gnang ba'i nang na yang thugs dam lhas dang de min yang bslab ston zhib rgyas bcas 'byor pa'ang rang gi blo de dang mthun par byung*/ mtshams mu nas dge sbyor la rtsol ba gang che bcugakhrid tshul gang de ba de ma yin par tshig spyi dang yig spyi la ma bltos pa'i don brgyud 'jug tshugs su ston pas gang la gang 'dul du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba zhes pa de nyid mngon sum du ston par mdzad de/

res 'ga' nyi ma gcig la yang rim pa na 'phar ba'i sgom kha lta phyogs bcu bcu tsam spro ba dang res 'ga' zhag bdun brgyad du yang gcig la 'jog pa sogs mngon sum lam byed kyi bka' drin stsal/ 'di skabs zab mo'i gnad kyi go ba sngar ma rtogs pa mang po 'di cug yin pa 'dra 'di ltar yin pa 'dug snyam pa chu drag tu khol ba'i lbu ba lta bur shar/ lta ba dang grub mtha' tha dad dang brjod tshul sna tshogs pa dag la zhen pa zhig cing 'gal 'dus skyon med kyi rnam par go / de sngon dang mi 'dra ba'i yid ches kyi gdeng ya mtshan can brjod mi shes pa zhig byung*/ 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa gnyis pa sbyar ro/ / bla ma'i zhal nas las rlung du snang ba'i 'khrul ba ma 'gags na 'gyur med kyi gnas la reg pa med pa'i nges tshig zab mo bstsal pa ltar/ chos kyi dbyings zab mo rtogs pa yang thabs kyis rtogs pa'o zhes nges pa brnyed/ de kho na nyid mchog thob nas nyin mtshan chad pa med pa rlung shi med go med du bkag cing*/ phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings la mnyam par bzhag pa na/ rang bzhin nam mkha' ltar 'gyur ba med pa la ye shes zla ba yar ngo bzhin 'char bar snang ngo*/ / 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa gsum sbyar ro/ / bar der gegs kyi rnam pa rigs mi gcig pa lnga tsam byung ba don du ni gegs ma yin te/ dmigs pa'i sgyur ka bstsal gdams pa gnang ba ltar bsgoms pas de nyid yon tan du gyur to/ / 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa bzhi pa sbyar ro/ / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang gong ma dang*/ dgyes pa rdo rje rngog lugs kyi dbang bskur ba bstsal bas dbang pa re re las ye shes 'bar ba re re byung zhing*/ khyad par he badzra dbang gi nub 'od gsal dang rmi lam 'dres pa'i snang ba ngo mtshar can mang du byung ngo*/ / 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa lnga pa sbyar ro/ / de nas ston dus ngam ring nus 'bod mi gzi 'bar ba gnang byung zhing*/

dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bka' lung gi khur yang blangs te sku gzhogs nas phyir 'ongs skabs/ gdan bzhugs phul ba'i thog tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bka' drin rjes dran gyi yon dbul ba mtshon byed dang bcas zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba btab/ de nas rgyan bu shel dkar dang bde gling sogs su'ang phyin/ 'dar gyi lcang gseb der chos rje bsod nams chos 'phel ba dang 'dar ba'i zhal ngo rnams kyis rgyas pa spros pa mdzad/ mthar gyis ngam ring du 'byor/ 'di skabs zhag nyi shu rtsa gsum tsam bsdad cing*/ zhal ngo rnams su sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang*/ tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya tshar dang*/ lha dgu ma brgya tshar/ rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang dang*/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dbang bskur ba rnams byas/ 'di byang du chos 'brel thog ma rang yin/ bzhi sde'i dbus mdzad pa dang*/ ri bo che ba'i rje drung brtan pa sogs 'ga' shas la nai gu'i dbang khrid cha tshang tsam dang*/ gzhan yang so so'i 'dod chos than thun zhu mi mang rab byung*/ 'di skabs pha ratna bha dra'i thugs sras gcig pu pa rje 'gyur med dang yang mjal/ chos kyi gsung sleng 'phel zhing dri ba che chung sna tshogs phebs kyi 'dug pa la blo tshod kyi lan re phul/ rje 'di pa la de gong sdom chen gyi dbang sogs chos zhu 'dod yod pa ni skabs der sangs song*/ slar yang 'di skabs chos lung byang rtse'i chos phyogs kyi khur 'khur dgos rnams byed dgos tshul phebs pas/ gtsang gzhung gi lam brgyud chos lung byung rtser sleb 'phral nas khong tsho'i mos bzhed mthar thug tu 'dug pas sgrub sde gang yod kyi steng du don gnyer ci rigs pas brgyan te grangs brgyad cu tsam la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig bshad/ 'di skabs khrid rang gi ngo bo shin tu smin par song zhing*/ lung pod nag ma yongs su rdzogs pa zhig las gzhan ma song*/

chos lung rang gi nyer mkho la sgos kyin yod pa ltar bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang dang*/ dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang rnams byas/ don gnyer 'dra la 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma'i dbang bskur zhig bgyis/ sman thang ba rang gi bzhed kyi mthar thug dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum rnams kyi byin rlabs dang khrid tshul gzhung drug gi lung sogs cha tshang bar bgyis/ rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i chos skor zab don bshad skabs/ rgyu rkyen gang yang med par sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor dang nang mchod ka li mchod stegs nas 'phar nas sa la lhung dkyil 'khor la skyon ni ma byung mod cung zad gnyan char mngon pa byung sman thang pa rang yang rtog pa zos/ rang dang lhan cig gnas pa grags bzang sogs la ma hā mā ya'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad ngag nas spar zhing*/ mā ya nyid kyi rgya gzhung 'grel pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi bshad pa zhib mor byas/ sgrub sde la chos khrims sogs kyis do dam byed gyu'i khungs tsam byas/ de skabs kun jo nang nas rje drung rin po che'i nye gnas rje drung nyid ltogs rir gtong mkhan kun blo ba zer ba'i rgod bro ba kho pas dpon sa mnga' bdag drung ltag khur gyis bar skabs der sgrigs gshig pa'i rtsing spyod rang byed pa zhig byung*/ 'di skabs rmi lam du mkhan po bka' drin can stag lung rin po che de/ bud med rta ba gnyis kyis lam sna byas tsa ri la phebs rgyu yin gsung pa ltar las chibs rgyugs mdzad phebs song ba la stag lung bas phebs bskyil ra mda' 'dra rjes la yong gyu ba dang*/ ngas mgyogs par rgyugs pas zhabs rjes zin chibs bshol nas bzhugs gdan la bzhugs su bcug pas/ 'o na da res thon tsam byed pa lags/ lar stag lung pa 'di kun la skyo ba skyes/ khyod kyis stag lung pa la phan 'dogs byung na gyis gsung ba zhig gsal po rmi ba las/ de 'phral brtan bzhugs 'bul mkhan brdzangs pas khong tshos sleb gong sku shin tu dub pa rang la brtan bzhugs phul 'phral rang sku khams yar so nas zhag bcu skor la sangs dwangs su byung bar gda'o/

/ de rjes jo nang du de lo'i khrid dus ran du tshugs khrid gsar pa yang mang rab byung*/ sbyor drug gi rgya gzhung rnams dang chos rje yab sras bcu bzhi'i rnam thar sogs kyi lung bklags/ tshogs chos ma gtogs zur chos bzhin gyi brel ba med par sems kyi lta phyogs kyang smar bar byung*/ bogs 'byed spogs pa'i cho ga bla ma'i zhal lung nas 'byung ba 'ga' zhig nyams su blangs pas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams kyi rtsal gong nas gong du na 'phar zhing rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba la cung zad gdang shar ro/ / 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa drug pa sbyar ro/ khrid gtor gyi tshe mi mang po'i 'du long zang zing sna tshogs yod pa rnams rang sems snang stong gi rang ngo tsam du shar/ de la brten de yid ches kyis drangs pa'i dga' bde zhag bdun tsam rgyun mi 'chad par byung zhing*/ de nas bags kyis dbyings su zhi nas btang snyoms chen po zhig gi ngang du gyur to/ / chos lung du sleb tsam nas rgyal mkhar rtse dang gting skyes nas 'bod mi car sdod yod pa dang*/ khyad par rje btsun bla ma dam pa'ang gting skyes su phebs 'dug pas hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyi shu skor la rim pas yar chas te lha rtse rdzong du 'tshom chen gyi logs bris la rab gnas zhig byas/ 'di skabs ri mo'i zhib cha rnams ni ma grub 'dugade nas kyang lam 'gor che se ba la gtir skyes su sleb/ dgon gsum gyi dge 'dun rnams lam 'bras shig dgos pa'i nan chags rang byung ba bzhin de'i gnangs nyin rang nas chos kyi 'go btsugs shing*/ khrid smin rgyas dang lung gi skor ni bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar cha tshang zhig dang lam 'bras yig sna drug cu po rdzogs par bklags/ de min lung gi spros pa spangs go don bshad pa rnams kyang mtha' chod par byas/ khrid zhu ba la zhal ngo rnams ma gtogs dge 'dun sha stag yin zhing sum brgya skor yor/ rgyu dbang la dbang cha bcu bdun tsam byung*/

sde pa'i dgongs bzhed ltar rgyud sde lnga'i dbang byas pa la dbang mi lnga bcu lhag tsam byung*/ zhang gi rigs kyi sngags pa bco lnga tsam dang sde pa yab sras don gnyer gzhan 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa dbang cha gcig la gshin rje gshed dgra nag zhang lugs kyi dbang bzhi drag po'i rjes gnang rgyas bsdus gnyis car dang bcas pa rdzogs par byas/ sngags pa kha cig la dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor gyi rjes gnang yang bgyis so/ / mchog gi bla ma dam pa la nyams dang myong ba/ gang yod shin tu zhib mor snyan du phul/ mdo rgyud man ngag rgya mtsho'i gnad 'dus pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa phebs pas tshig re res kyang mdud pa mang du khrol yangs t-ing gi song*/ khyad par rang nyid kyi blo'i 'char tshul las brtsams te/ gnas lugs kyi ye shes gcer mthong 'dzug tshugs su ngo sprod gnang bas ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i chos thams cad kyi don gyi brgyud pa thob/ 'di tsam nas gzung mkhas 'dod dbyings su yal/ sgra sogs phyi rol gyi rig gnas thams cad byis pa'i rtsed mo lta bur go / thar lam ston pa'i mdo sngags kyi chos chen po rnams la sngar las ches lhag pa'i mos gus skyes na'ang thos bsam gyi sred pa dang brel ba zhig byung*/ de ltar gang dang yang mnyam pa med pa'i bka' drin stsal te gcig chog rgyal po rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes bsam pa thag pa nas dang ba dang 'dun pa dang yid ches pa'i bdag nyid du gyur te/ 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa bdun pa sbyar ro/ / bla mas kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i mngon par dbang bskur bas dbang bskur te skabs 'dir zhal gyi gdams pa mang po zhig dang*/ rgyud 'bum gyi 'phros phal che ba'i lung yang legs par thob po/ / 'dir smras pa/ gnas lugs gdong lngas khyab pa'i nags klung du/ / spros pa gnyis 'thung dbang po sder bcas bcom/ / dus gcig stong gsum bgrod pa yid mgyogs stobs/ /gcig car chos kun rig pa bla ma'i drin/

/ 'di skabs dge grong gi phyed ka 'phros ma gting skyes kyi phyag na yod pa de yang chos gzhis su sbyor 'jags gnang byung*/ lam 'bras kyi khrid grol nas gam pa nas rab 'byams pa legs bshad 'bod mir gnang byung ba bzhin phyin zhag bdun tsam bsdad cing nag po pa'i dbang bskur zhig dang*/ gzhan tshe bka' rjes gnang sogs dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ dge grong kol chu tshan kha srad tang tang gi gzhung rnams brgyud mag dge sdings mjal/ 'dol byung du zhag shas bsdad/ bsam 'grub rtser sde pa sku 'bring ba'i drung mgul shin tu bsnyil ba'i stabs nas dbang bka' sogs zhu bzhed kyi 'bod mi gnang byung ba ltar bsam rtser sleb/ de gong du sku khams de la zhud kha sdang ba rang zhig yod 'dug de phyin nas ma byung zhing*/ zhal ngo spyi khyab tu tshe bka' ci rigs dang*/ sku sgos su tshe dbang brgya tshar phyag na rdo rje gtum po ras chung lugs kyi dbang sogs dang rjes gnang mang ba tsam phul/ shar steng nas sras yum du dpal kyai'i rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba dgongs bzhed ltar bsgrubs/ skyes rabs brgya rtsa mdzad bcu dang bcas pa'i zhal thang gsar bzhengs thog tshad ma nyi shu rtsa lnga pa cig 'dug pa la rab gnas byas/ slar yang tshong 'dus dbu rtser zhag shas bsdad/ grwa lnga'i drung dang thugs snang dag pa'i gsung gleng smra ba nyid chos kyi gtso bor byas/ da lam dbus phyogs su 'gro rgyur 'dug pa lo gcig tsam nas yar phebs pa zhig dgos de min ma mjal dogs pa yin gsung gin 'dugade nas yar lam dga' gdong pa rnams kyis 'bod mi byung ba ltar khor tsam phyin 'du khang du khri la 'khod nas dge 'dun rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig chos 'brel du byas/ dpal bsam sdings su slob dpon mchog gi zhabs drung du/ 'od zer dgu phrugs kyi byin rlabs dang a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dbang chos 'brel tu zhus shing*/ mi g.yo bla med kyi dbang chos 'brel du dgos phebs pa ltar phar phul/

'khor lo bde mchog dkar po rnam par rtsen pa'i byin rlabs de chos 'brel gyi rjes mar 'bul dgos byung zhing*/ gang spyi'i gnas tshul 'das ma 'ongs kyi bka' bkod thams cad kyang mthar dam pa'i chos kyi zab don dang 'brel ba kho na gnang ba dang*/ snga phyi'i gnas tshul zhib cha 'bul ba sogs kyis nam phyed phyed sku gzhogs su 'gor ba sha stag byung zhing*/ sku khams log dogs byung na'ang yang nas yang du bka' phebs la da sgos dbus phyogs 'khor ba'i myur du mjal bar smon te phal cher da mi mjal 'am bu tshe'i 'du byed gtong khar sngar mgor bzhugs pa zhig byung na dgos pa gda' ste snga phyi'i rten 'brel rnams la dpags na mi yong ba 'duga'am bus nan chags su zhus na lo shas nye skor 'di kar bzhugs pa zhig los yong du 'dug ste/ stag lung nas bla ma'i bka' bkod kyang yin pa dang gzhan phan gyi bar chad mi byed da ras kyi res la gsung 'phros/

smar ba rang byed dgos phebs shing 'phros gtam 'bul ba la bsdad pa rang la dgyes par 'dug pas nyin mtshan thams cad sku gzhogs rang du bsdad/ sgrub sde ba rnams la nai gu zhig kyang bshad/ dpal ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi sku 'bum zhig gsos kyi zhal bkod slob dpon rin po che nyid kyis gnang bar mdzad cing*/ de ka'i bka' bgros zhu 'os thams cad thag chod par zhus/ bdag cag dpon slob snga mo nas rdzas gcig yin na'ang*/ slob dpon rin po che nyid kyi phyag rdzas dang gnas 'byi drung chen gyi rdzas kyi steng nas sku skal gang yod las phal cher de gong nyid nas dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog gtso bor gyur pa'i dkar phyogs kho na la gnang zin cing/ de rjes kyi dngos kyi rdzas gang yod dang bla ma dam pa nyid kyi phyag gi'ang gang yod rnams gcig tu bsgril de zhig gsos kyi thes su dmigs de bzhagad lta bla ma mang po nor ngom mdzo rta ngom/ g.yog mang ba rang ngaum/ sbyin bdag ngom/ yon mchod thams cad chibs rags ngom/ kha drag ngom par gda'/ tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab ni ngom rgyu med pa la gang ngom/ phaṭa/ 'di skabs zhag nyi shu tsam sku gzhogs su bsdad cing dam rdzas ril bu rta sgrub cig kyang mdzad pa bdud rtsi 'bab pa sogs rtags ni sgrub pa dngos las kyang che cha tsam byung*/ de nas kyang zhag shas sdod 'dod yod na'ang*/ rtse chen nas dpon sa yum drung sku tshes ma zin pa'i 'gro dgos shar zhing*/ der sku drin mtshungs med slob dpon rin po che de nyid kyi zhabs zung 'bral bar mi spobs bzhin du 'ongs/ kha ba chen po babs pas lam yang bcad pa bzhin du song*/ phyis mi mjal ba'i rten 'brel du 'dugartse chen rang du mun sros pa la sleb/ khrus chog dbang bskur mtshan byang bzhu ba sogs gang dgos thams cad bgyis shing*/ sbyangs yon dbu khebs de byung ba'ang zhig gsos kyi rgyur 'dre bar song*/

dgongs rdzogs grol 'phral lhun grub bde chen du rje grub chen gyi sku 'bum mjal rgyal mkhar rtser phyin 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa dang gshin rje gshed nag gi dbang sogs zhal ngo spyi khyab tu dgongs bzhed kyi chos mang tsam dang*/ zhabs drung bla ma'i drung du dgyes pa rdo rje rngog lugs kyi yab bka' dang yum bka'i dbang*/ rdzogs rim bsre 'pho'i khrid dang lung yongs rdzogs sogs dgongs bzhed ltar gyi chos sna mang po dang*/ mdo rtsa'i gzhi stod kyi byed tsam thugs 'dzug khrid kyi bshad pa zhig kyang phul/ gnas rnying nas 'bod mi nan can gnang byung ba ltar dpal gnas rnying gi chos grwa chen por phyin/ rje drung ngag dbang drung dang rje drung 'jam dbyangs drung sogs zhal ngo rnams dang mjal/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa bar chad kun sel dang yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang sogs dgongs bzhed kyi chos bka' mang rab phul zhing*/ gdung brgyud rin po ches kyang dbu skra gsil bar mar ba byung tsam gnang*/ 'di skabs 'tshub cha che ba rang 'dugaye shes mgon po'i 'phur thang gtso bor gyur pa'i phyi nang gi rten khyad par can thams cad mjal/ gser sdings pa'i grwa tshang rnams gnas rnying na chos bar la bzhugs 'dug pas gnas rnying gi 'du khang du khong rnams la chos 'brel du bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig dang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi le'u dang po'i lung bklags/ slar yang rgyal rtser dge tsha'i sgang der phyi mtsham me ba byas/ 'ga' zhig la dza landha ra'i do ha nged rang gi rnam bshad kyi steng nas tshar gcig bshad/ slar rtse chen du yong dgos tshul phebs pa ltar khor tsam phyin zhing 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma'i dbang*/ gzungs grwa lnga'i dbang*/ tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs byas/ yang rgyal rtser chos rje rin sdings pa dus 'khor shar chen pa chos rje lha'o pa gzhan grwa rigs don gnyer che ba mang rab dang bcas pa la/

thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chos kyi rgyal po'i bzhed srol ltar sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid dang*/ khrid yig ngo sprod sogs kyi lung*/ sems nyid ngal gso'i khrid rnams bgyis yum mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i nang rten rje dam pa'i sku 'dra bzang sku ngo mtshar can bsgrubs pa gnang 'dug pa/ snga gong slob dpon rin po ches rab gnas rgyas pa gnang 'dugadangos la'ang zhal ngo rnams kyis bka' phebs ltar rab gnas rgyas pa rang bgyis/ 'di skabs su lcags 'dam chos rje'i drung gis a khu ba 'das pa'i don la rong grags par yong dgos tshul gyi nan chags rang mdzad na'ang*/ 'phral rang ngu don gal che ba gzhan zhig kyang yong snyam pa blo yul du lam lam 'char ba zhig gi stabs nas 'gro ma thub/ de skabs dgos gal che sar phan ma thogs na'ang 'khang ra med par mos pa 'phel ba ngo mtshar che/ hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum la rtse nas thon mar lam sde pa mkhar kha ba'i spur la khrus chog dang byang bzhu grub nas/ gnas rnying nas dpon sa'i drung shin tu sku khams bsnyel ba'i myur shad yong dgos tshul byung bas de 'phral lam bsrangs nas phyin pa sleb dus dpon sa'i drung ni sku ma 'tsho 'dugaspur la khrus chab dang dbang bskur byas/ 'pho ba'i dmigs pa dang rten 'brel 'dra bgyis pas de 'phral rang 'pho ba thebs pa'i rtags gsal ba thon/ rje zhal ngor chos kyi tshul las brtsams te thugs gso gang drag bgyis/ rje drung sku mched rnams kyang da res khyed kyis yod du bcug pa'i bka' bkod thugs thag pa nas phebs kyi 'dugazhag gsum pa'i nam phyed tsam la spur 'od bzhu byas nyi shar la mtshan byang bzhug ste/ de mtshams lam du zhugs rim pas chas/ mkha' ro'i la 'og tu mthong snang gi khyad par byung ba ni yi ge logs su bkod yod pa ltar shes par bya'o/ / mkha' ro gangs sbug tu sleb cing*/ yar 'brog nas sde pa a khu drung pa dpon g.yog rnams kyang gzhis len la phebs 'dugatshe dpag med kyi lha khang gsar ba der sdod sa byas/

sde pa dpon g.yog rnams ni lug mjal gyi thugs brel sogs nas de'i gnangs nyin phebs song*/ nged kyis gnas de nyid du zhag bcu skor tsam mtshams byas/ char zhod dang smugs zil shin tu che ba dang cham pa shin tu na ba byung na'ang*/ sngar mkha' ro'i la 'og gi mthong snang dang bstun pa'i sems la bde snang gi 'char sgo brjod pa las 'das pa zhig shar ba thams cad kyang dbyings shar dbyings grol gyi tshul du gyur te/ / lus kyi zug ngu yang dbyings su yal ba ltar 'gro ba ka byung ngo*/ / 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa brgyad pa sbyar ro/ / de nas tshes nyer gsum la yar 'brog stag lung du sleb/ sdod yul rtse'i gzhal yas khang du byas shing*/ zhal ngo rnams la thog mar sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang rten 'brel legs pa'i phyir phul nas/ tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs song rjes/ da lam thugs bzhed kyi gtso bo shangs chos yongs rdzogs rang yin pa cis kyang dgos phebs pa ltar de mthun phul ba ni/ dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor so sor dbang bskur ba dang gcig car bskur ba ste/ nyi ma bdun gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rdzogs pa dang*/ zab lam chos drug sogs gser chos kyi khrid rnams dang*/ byin rlabs gzhung bka' nyi shu/ rgyab rten lung yig rnying po ti gnyis tsam/ de dag tu ma 'dus pa 'chi med 'khrul 'khor gyi dbang dang khrid/ thugs rje chen po zhi drag sogs shangs chos cha tshang zhig song*/ mgon bka' rnams ma gtogs pa la don gnyer sha stag 'dus pa bzhi bcu zhe bgrangs yod cing*/ khrid dmigs skyor dgos pa sogs nan tan yang dag byas/ zhal ngo rnams la sgrol dkar gyi tshe khrid dang*/ lcam sring gnyis su sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa/ sde pa ma'i drung la nai gu'i lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor rnams kyang dgos phebs pa ltar phul/ gzhan don gnyer mang dag zhig la gsang 'dus rim lnga mar 'gos gnyis 'dus kyi lugs bu ston rin po che'i khrid yig steng nas khrid zhib pa zhig dang rgya gzhung rnams dang 'gos ky-i gtong thun chen mo'i lung bshad cig kyang bgyis/

zhal ngo rnams su dmar po skor gsum sogs gzhan yang chos mang dag song*/ rje lcags nang ba dbon slob thams cad dang mjal chos 'brel yang phul/ khong dpon slob tshos nged la brtan bzhugs kyang mdzad/ 'di skabs sde pa khu dpon gyi gsung las da lo lha sa la skor chen zhig 'dzugs rgyu yin pas de ga'i mgo byed dgos gsung ba byung na'ang mi byed par thag bcad/ 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa dgu pa sbyar ro/ / de rjes zhal ngo so so nas chos yon yang bzab ma dang*/ sde pa rgyal bu'i drung gis brgya 'bul zhig mdzad skabs/ 'tshom chen gyi steng 'og khengs pa tsam gyi chos zhu mi la/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i sgo nas sems bskyed phog cing*/ de rjes sna dkar rtser chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i sku 'dra sme ba can la snam sbyar bzang ba zhig phul/ de nas rim pas chas de skyes yul tu sleb/ ri ltas la phyin pas yul gyi bkod pa sna tshogs mthong ba la brten pa'i yid kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs pa rang bzhin dag ba'i ngo bor rang ngor mnyam pa'i/ dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ / longs spyod yul du du mar snang*/ / shel la tshon ni ji bzhin du/ / zhes pa la nges pa rnyed par byung*/ de skabs sna dkar rtse'i bde yangs su wa brgyal ba sogs ltas 'tshub pa byung bas ji ltar bya gsung ba'i lon gnang byung ba de sku la gnod pa cang med yul chags chen po zhig yod pa 'dra zhus/ ston dus 'gol zhing rig pa dwangs ba la brten de 'chad spro bar byung nas/ rang gi lhan cig gnas pa don gnyer drug bdun la rgyud sde thams cad kyi mthar thug pa byin rlabs kyi gter chen po 'khor lo sdom pa bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa yongs su rdzogs par bshad cing*/ spyir rgyud 'di la rgya bod kyi 'grel ba'i dpe cha nag 'ded la bltos mi dgos pa'i zab mo'i nges gnas la rang dbang 'byor tsam gdog/

de yang rang blo rno ba kho nas min/ bla ma dam pa rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnam pa lnga'i thugs rje dang*/ rang gi bsod nams dang brtson 'grus 'dzoms pa las byung ba lags/ 'on kyang 'di skabs sngar srol dang bstun gnyan phul byung ba'i ṭīkka la gzhi byas te/ man ngag gi bshad sgros gzhan rnams dang*/ lwa ba pa'i 'grel ba nas ci rigs par kha skang ste/ snga gro nyi ma shar lhod tsam nas kha zas gdan gcig po ngan gyi bar dang*/ zas kyi bya ba grol 'phral nas nyi ma nub kyi bar bshad cing*/ sngags btu'i byin rlabs gong 'og sogs skabs de dang der dgos pa'i byin rlabs rnams kyang tshogs 'khor gyi bya ba dang 'brel par bsgrubs shing*/ dbu zhabs bar gsum gyi rgyud mchod kyi tshogs 'khor dang thun re bzhin tu thog mar bsrung 'khor gtor chog maṇḍal gsol btab sogs dang 'jug tu yi rang brjod pa sogs phyag len go rim ma 'khrul bar bgyis/ 'on kyang chos thun snga phyi'i lag len spros pa 'di lag len rnying pa rang yin min mi shes pa 'duga'aphral rnam pa gsal gsal bo cig snang*/ bshad thun ches bas nyan pa bo rnams kyi blo la 'jag pa rang ma byung na'ang*/ rang nyid kyi blo ngo la dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje btsun mos rgyud byin gyis rlob kyin yod snyam pa'i yin dga' spro dang bcas pa rtag tu byung*/ rmi lam du bud med kyi gzugs can 'ga' res rgyud kyi tshig 'bru'i bshad pa la dag ma dag gi dpyad pa byed pa yang lan mang du byung bas/ phyis 'byung dang deng sang shes rab che ru re ba rnams dpe lung tsam re'am spyi bshad tsam re brgyud pa'i khungs su byas nas/ rang gi dpe lta 'dra byas pa'i yid dpyod la zab don yin par 'ung 'gog 'thag pa/ mkhas pas mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje'i tshig 'chad pa/ zhes pa'i lung gis zin pa'i bshes gnyen chen po/ rtog ge pa la rdo rje slob dpon gyi khral bkal ba rnams kyi nyan bshad dang mi 'dra ba'i byin rlabs gyi rtags mtshan can du gda'/

pha jo'i drung la mnal lam ma yin pa'i gsal snang ci rigs 'char ba zhig yod pas/ rgyud kyi gung tsam la sleb skabs kyi tho rangs shig bud med cig gis pu rangs lo chung chos 'chad pa la byon zer ba'i skad gsal po thengs gsum gsan pa byung 'dug cing*/ bshad pa de nyid grol mtshams bsnyen pa 'dra'i kha gso bgyis/ de grol mtshams sam bu ṭa dang rnal 'byor ma kun sbyod kyi lung bshad 'doms/ sdom 'byung gi lung rnams byas/ 'di skabs rgya ma'i grwa tshang gi slob dpon pa chos mdzad rgyan yang nged la 'bod pa la byon byung*/ de nas lhun rab tu zhag bdun tsam bsdad/ 'dod chos 'dra byas/ rgya ma slob dpon pa dang rang gi lhan cig gnas pa 'ga' zhig la/ skyes bu gsum gyi khrid lam rim rgyas pa'i 'go tshugs shing*/ rgyab rten du gam la shi la'i sgom rim thog mtha' bar gsum gyi lung bshad kyi 'go yang tshugs/ rin spungs nas zhabs drung zla bzang pa'i drung yang skyed tshal 'og na bzhugs 'dug pas/ khro phu rgya rdza'i lung zhig dgos phebs pa de skabs stod cha tsam song*/ slob dpon grub thob pa'i drung yang chos 'brel zhu ba la byon byung*/ yol ri gong du rang byon mgon po'i zhal khyim mjal bar phyin/ bar skabs su mgon khang la dmag thebs pa'i cung zad chag grugs byung zer/ sngon dus ltar gyi byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan med dam snyam pa tsam byung na'ang*/ zhal ras mthong ba tsam gyis snang ba 'gyur ba sogs byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan sngon dus kyi de kho na bzhin du 'dugade nub rang byon mgon po nyid kyi drung du mchod gtor bskang gso bzab mar byas/ mgon po'i sku drung de nyin du nyal nas bsdad pas/ rmi lam du bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pas rjes su bzung ba'i rtags snang cung zad byung*/ nang par yang snga rab langs te smon lam mang du btab/ rang byon mgon po nyid dang gnyan ston gyi nang rten thub pa'i sku 'dra la snyan dar dri bzang gi mchod pa rin po che dang bsres pa mang du phul/

mgon khang du spyan gzigs dang lha gzhan rnams la yang snyan dar bla bre 'phan sogs mchod rdzas than thun 'bul rgyu byung*/ mar lam khu spe grwa tshang du chos 'brel 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang dang gang blo ma'i byin rlabs byas/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sku 'dra phyag gnas ma dang*/ gser gdung la phyag mchod phul/ snga nas 'bod mi nan can yod pa bzhin/ de nub sa sribs la gong dkar du sleb/ 'di the ba'i thog ma lan gsum ka sa sros pa la sleb pa rkyang byung ba bkra legs rgyu rang mi snang ste/ rten 'brel gzhan cung zad legs pas re shig gzhan las grag pa byung*/ gang ltar de skabs sdod yul mgon po me thub ma bzhugs pa'i steng der byung*/ zhabs drung mi dbang drung du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang tshe dbang grub brgyal ma brgya rtsa lha dgu ma brgya rtsa sogs phul zhing*/

bdag mo'i drung gi phyag phyir don gnyer nyi shu tsam dang bcas pa la dzambha la dkar po dang sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang*/ khyad par bde mchog lha lnga'i smin byed kyis sgo phye ste/ phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i khrid tshul shin tu smin pa dang*/ zhabs drung gdung brgyud du tshe dbang sogs sku tshe'i rten 'brel gyi dbang bka' rjes gnang ci rigs pa phul/ sngar gyi 'phros la bka' gdams lam rim gyi 'khrid tshul rgyab rten gyi bshad pa rgyas pa dang bcas pa/ sgom rim gyi lung bshad rgyas pa dang*/ de skabs ba'i sde dbu mdzad pa phyis tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan thog tu phebs pa rin po che rta ra ba'i drung la mtshan brjod kyi 'grel chen sngags don rnam gzigs kyi lung bshad cig dgos gsung ba ltar rngog pa'i ngag sgros dang sgrel nas bshad pa zhib rab byas/ de dus chu bo ri'i lcags zam chad yar 'brogs pa'i skor chen gyi mi mang po shi skabs yin/ sngar gyi bde mchog gi rgyud bshad nyan pa po rnams la yang mngon brjod bla ma'i lung bshad rdzogs pa dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lung gnad 'doms kyi bshad pa dang bcas pa rdzogs par byas/ dkon gnyer nyi rnam pa sogs don gnyer 'ga' zhig la nai gu chos drug byin rlabs dang bcas pa zhig dang*/ zhal ngo rnams dang drung 'khor drag bsdus dang*/ jo gdan bzhi ste/ yol mkhan chen sogs dge bshes mang dag dang bcas pa phyed nyis brgya tsam la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ gzhan yang bde mchog nag po pa dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi dbang*/ bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang*/ rim lnga'i byin rlabs/ dril bu rim lnga'i khrid bshad pa mtha' chod dang bcas pa/ jo gdan 'ga' zhig la skyid sdug lam khyer gyi khrid sogs mdor na 'di skabs zla gcig zhag po nyi shu skor la chos shin tu 'phel ba byung*/

hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la drang srong srin pa rir sleb tsam byas/ de nub lha khang der nyal bas gnyid kyi 'od gsal mtshan zang thal gyis zin/ gnas der rten 'brel gyi sgo bzang po cig 'grig la khad la yal song*/ nang par 'jun du khor tsam phyin tshe dbang sogs bzhed pa ltar byas/ sras mo chung chung zhig gi skra phud blangs/ de nub sdod dgos tshul nan chags rang byed kyin 'dug na'ang ltas ngan pa zhig 'dug pas ma bsdad/ sang 'u shang rdo'i gnas mjal byas te/ de nas rgya sde dkar chung gi rdo rings kyi bka' tshigs yi ge de ched btang mjal bar phyin/ de nas zhabs drung bkras stobs pa'i phyag g.yog mdo sngags gling pa'i sku skye bsu bar byung*/ de nub ra sa 'phrul snang du zhabs drung bkras stobs drung dang mjal ba/ sngar ma mjal nas shin tu yun ring bar song bas phan tshun yid kyi ngal stegs su gyur/ 'di skabs lha sar zhag bzhi bsdad cing phyag mchod smon lam gang 'grub byas/ nub mo shin tu 'tshub pa'i cho 'phrul dang 'od gsal gyi snang cha re mos rang du 'char ba zhig byung*/ 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad kyi ya rgyal bar khang gi gyang ris sgrol ma'i sku brnyan la byang dar sngon po bzang ba zhig phul ba bzhes pa'i rnam pa byung ba rdzun med thams cad kyis mthong de ka yin/ zhabs drung bkras stobs drung du phag dkar shes rab gsal byed paṇa chen nags rin nas brgyud pa'i nye brgyud de'i byin rlabs shig phul/ yar lam yer bar zhag gsum bsdad/ dpon sa yum drung nas nged kyis rta lo yongs pa'i dus nas gzung yer par rab lo gsum tsam/ de min yang lo mtshams tsam zhig byed dgos rtag tu phebs pa zhig yod na yang*/ de skabs 'gyur 'dug pas lo gsum ma zhag gsum la bsdus/ spyir bskal dus rnyings pa'i slob ma phal cher dang*/ khyad par sde dpon phra rags phal cher zhig mthu bzlog sogs rkyen sel lam 'jig rten gyi phan bya 'di las 'di e grag snyam pa dang*/

'ga' zhig thob rgya 'dra 'dod pa dang zas ngo nor ngo sogs la su byung byung bla mar 'khur chos gang thob byed/ de rjes dam tshig la ye mi rtsi ba zhig yong bar gnang*/ don du ni de 'dra de dmyal ba'i sgrub thabs chen por gda'/ 'brom chen po'i gsung las/ kho bos tsham tshom du bla ma bsten ma myong*/ bsten nas yal bar 'dor ma myong gsung ba gnad kyi dam par snang ngo*/ / spos kha'i dgon pa na rje btsun ma la yer ba ba'i sku 'dra 'gro mgon skye med zhang gis bzhengs pa byin rlabs can de mjal/ ri bo dge ldan mjal 'dod che ba rang yod na yang de skabs stabs ma 'grigargya ma rin chen sgang du skye bo grangs med pa tshogs pa la nyin re bzhin du rgyu 'bras kyi chos kyis rgyud bskul ba sngon du 'gro bas khrom chos re 'chag med du bshad/ khyad par kyai rdo rje'i dbang cha drug tsam dang*/ gzhan yang gang la gang 'tsham gyi chos kyang 'phel rab byung zhing*/ nyin re bzhin tshogs 'khor rgyas pa 'dren mkhan bzhi lnga re ma chag pa byung*/ nub mo khyi zhig rgyun du zug gin 'dug pa la skad kyi gdangs la yig drug gi sgra gsal bo rang lhang lhang ba ja sbyor gcig tsam gyi bar du byung*/ nye skor gyi yul pa thams cad 'tshogs pa'i mi tshogs shin tu che ba zhig la ma ṇi'i lung dang khrom dbang zhig byas/ snga gong lha sa'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa smin pa zhig 'dir skyen gyis sad pas/ phyi'i snang ba thams cad sgyu ma tsam dang*/ nang rig pa nam mkha' lta bu dbyer med khyab brdal lhongs su gyur/ phyi snang cha ji tsam mang gin bogs che ba/ lus la 'pho med kyi bde ba 'char ba/ rlung yang mnyam rgyur 'gro ba dang nang gi sgra'i gsang ba la brten te ngag thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur te/ legs nyes mtho dman gyi tshig thams cad mnyam nyid du shar/ da lta'i dus na sgom chen pa kha cig rang phyogs kyi skyon shi gsang ro gsang dang 'char ka byung dogs kyi dogs pa ri tsam khong du bcug nas chos brgyad rang ngom zhing*/

lkog tu lus ngag yid gsum shin tu ma dag pas dus 'da' ba dag la snying rje khong nas skyes/ snga sor mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig gi sel cung zad cig gi ltas yang yang byung bas/ 'dir mkha' 'gro ma'i gtor ma shin tu tshad che ba rgya che dpangs mtho rang bshams nas gtor ma lan brgya tshar bsngo ba sogs rang gis kyang bgyis shing*/ dam tshig gtsang ba rnams bsngor 'jug pa lan mang du bstud nas byas pas sel dag cing mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rtags rnams tshang bar byung ngo*/ / 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa bcu pa sbyar ro/ / 'dir smras pa/ gang zhig srid pa gsum du chos kyi gtam/ / lan brgyar bsgrags pa 'di yang rmad du byung*/ / de dag las kyang dngos kun rgyal srid la/ / rang sems gcig car 'khor 'di ches cher mtshar/ / de nas bye ri stag rtser zhag sbrel zhig bsdad/ dpon sa zhol nas gyi sras mo chung chung zhig gi skra bcad/ sa der smon mkhar sde pa'i gzhis sa cha thams cad rje drung zhwa dmar bar phul ba'i phyi nang gi skad cha zhib par tshor bas/ kho rang tsho'i 'dod pa skyabs zhwa dmar can la zhus/ dbang rigs khong rang tshor yong la re nas zhus 'dug pa la gzigs stangs 'dzol nas sa gzhis thams cad rje zhwa dmar bas phyag tu bzhes pas phyis 'gyod/ de yin ni ka bzhi ras chen shor ba'i phyag rjes yin/ sbyin pa rgya che yang bsam pa ma dag pas 'bras bu chung ba/ bshes gnyen dam pas ma zin pa mtshar snyam pa yang yang shar/ de nas dga' mor chos rgyal 'phags pa'i sku 'dra 'bul thob ma la snyan dar phyag mchod sogs phul/ rje btsun mar pa lo tsā ba'i thugs dam rten yin nges bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil thang rgya gar ma zhig bzhugs ky-in 'dug pas/ de sngas 'gor spyan drangs te tshogs mchod phul zhing nub mo bzlas pa mang rab byas nas nyal bas/ rmi lam du slob dpon mtsho skyes dang*/ lwa ba pa gnyis kyi phug yin zer ba brag phug shin tu nyams dga' ba kha sprod cig 'dugagacig na bud med sngo sangs gcig dang gcig na dmar mo gcig 'dugalhan cig skyes las gang skyes pa/

/ lhan cig skyes par de brjod bya/ / rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ / rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig/ de yi don 'di yin zhes rgyas par gsung ba dang*/ rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dag/ ces pa nas mchog tu dga' ba'i rigs las byung ba rnams/ zhes pa'i bar rkang bro dang bcas nas glur blangs/ bum pa zhig dang*/ thod pa zhig dang*/ ong pu gru gsum gyi dbus na sdong bu la me 'bar bzhin pa zhigasnod chus gang ba zhigame tog 'dab ma bdun pa zhiganor bu yin zer ba'i rdo sngon po zhig rnams lag tu gtad byung ba/ dbang bzhi sogs zab mo'i brda' don du go / lar nged la mar rngog lugs 'di kun la bag chags sad rgyu cig 'dugade nas chos sdings su zhag gsum tsam bsdad cing*/ grwa rigs grang dpon so so'i nang du 'bod mi rnam grangs mang ba rang gis brel bar byung*/ mgon po lha brgyad dang lha bcu gnyis ma/ dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang*/ pu ṭa'i zur bka' sogs bzhes don gyi chos 'ga' re byas/ zur ru ba tshang dang yu nga sdings pa tshang la nyin 'khor zhig phyin/ sdings pa'i de na na land+re'i ra ba smad pa rnams chos bar la bzhugs 'dugakhong rnams kyis kyang nged la chos 'brel zhig zhus song*/ sgro rong du gnas bcu'i gser thang gsar bzhengs la rab gnas bsdus pa zhig byas/ lhun grub rdzong gi klu sdings su stag lung nas sde pa'i drung dang mjal/ 'di nyin rang gdung rgyud gcig sku bltams pa de da lta'i stag lung rin po che 'di ka rang yin rten 'brel legs/ tshes bco lnga'i nyi phyed tsam la rnam rgyal rab brtan du sleb ba'i sa gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ rje btsun stag lung ba chen po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs pad mchog gi drung du 'byor zhing zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong bas dga' bde dpag tu med pa thob/ 'di skabs su mkhas pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon rin po che jo nang du phebs pa'i dus khrid sogs gnang dgos tshul snyan du phul ba bzhin phyag thog tu yang khel 'duganged kyis zla gcig skor rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dpal stag lung ba chen po'i zhabs drung du/

'gro mgon phag mo grub pa'i bka' 'bum gyi 'phros sngar ma thob pa rnams dang*/ rje ri bo che ba'i bka' 'bum phal che ba zhig gi lung rnams zhus shing*/ rnam rgyal rab brtan du sleb pa'i gnangs nyin yang dgon du sprul pa'i sku yang mjal/ de mthun grog khar yang mjal shangs lugs kyi rgyud sde lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa khyad par du 'phags pa zhig sgrub brgyud 'di nyid kyi zhabs tog tu dmigs nas sbyar/ rje 'bab rong pa chen po'i dngul sku rin po che sogs 'bab rong pa'i rten rnams stag lung gling na phebs 'dus pa'ang mjal/ mgur 'bum gyi dpe mthong bas bag chags sad rgyu gsha' ma zhig 'dugahor dpon sa skyong dang g.yul rgyal gnyis dang phrad tshe dbang gcig byas/ stong pa'i dpon a chos kyang byon 'dug stag lung ba'i sku tsha yin kyang mchod gnas ngan pas sbos 'dug phrad ma byung*/ de mtshams nas rje bla ma'i gzims khang de nyid du mtshams bcad/ nyi phyed tsam nas gung thun la rtsom pa'i thun che ba re byas/ srod thor snga dgongs rnams bzlas brjod dang mnyam gzhag kyang 'phel bar byung*/ bka' babs bdun ldan gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang*/ khyad par lhan cig tu gnas pa'i don gnyer mang pos rab tu bskul ba la brten nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi bstod chen dngos grub 'byung gnas kyi 'grel chen de brtsams pas/ thog ma dka' 'grel tsam byed par bsams te/ phyag 'tshal gyi skor rnams la de kha bzhin byas pa yin na'ang*/ de man chad la 'bru bshad dgag sgrub dgos pa sogs la rab 'byams pa rgyal mtshan 'od zer gyis bshad pa dpyis phyin pa rang dgos tshul gyis 'phral 'phral bskul ba la brten bshags pa nas brtsams te/ rgyas 'brel rang du song hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu la 'go brtsams te chu stod zla ba'i tshes bcu la rdzogs par grub/ 'di rang re'i rtsom pa snga rtsom gyi gtso bo yin/ legs so thob pa'i mtshan ma tsam dang khyad par rim gnyis spyi'i bshad pa song mtshams kyi nub gcig rmi lam du rnam rgyal rab brtan gyi shar gyi ri de'i ngos shin tu 'jam zhing snyoms pa mthing shog bkrams pa lta bu la mtshal yig bzab chung gi rnam par zhig gis ri'i ngos go mtshams med par song 'dug pa/

bud med kyi khrom chen po zhig kyang ri de'i rtsa ba na 'dugade'i gtso mo de mi'i lus la mig gsum dang ldan pa zhig 'dug pas 'di ni zhing gi rnal 'byor ma zhig go snyam ste g.yon phyogs nas lan gsum bskor te/ rgyud nas bshad pa ltar brda'i phyag dang yid kyis dri ba byed kyin 'dug pas gtso mo de na re/ ri sa hā dzā/ zhes lan gsum gsung*/ ri logs kyi yi ge 'di rnams ci yin klog tu rung ngam dris pas/ 'di mngon brjod 'bum pa chen po le'u 'bum yod pa de yin/ de yang shes rab rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs pa ni 'di tsam zhig 'tshogs pa yin pa las thabs su gyur pa ni khyed gcig pu ste/ des na 'khor lo'i mchod pa 'di thog mar gyis la phyis klogs shig ces gsung zhing*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod par snang ba mang po zhig las mthar tshogs kyi bya ba zin pa na/ de rnams bklags pas ri logs chen po yi ge phra mos khyab pa de yud tsam gyis klog zin pa dang don rnams kyang blo la ram ram yod pa snyam byed/ gnyid sad pa'i tshe yang sngar ma go ba'i don nyi shu tsam zhig gsal le 'dugayang lan cig rmi lam du khang pa'i ngos la sdig pa rwa can shin tu che ba zhig btags 'dug pa rlung gis bdas de gdong la lan gsum phog byung ba rmi lam ma zin par 'jigs skrags chen po byung*/ de 'phral rmi lam zin byung na'ang*/ da res rmi lam ma zin da ste nam zhig bar do'ang mi zin pa 'dra snyam sems skyo shas chen po byung*/ de 'od gsal du gyur de mtha' dbus med par song*/ dpal ldan 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i mngon rtogs chen mo 'di yang snga ma'i rjes thogs la brtsams pa yin te nyi ma bzhi la grub par byas/ dbyar gyi ring rje btsun stag lung pa chab tshan sogs kyi stabs nas byang rgyab la phebs pa gnang song*/ slar phebs mtshams nged kyis 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi gnas chen mjal bar dmigs phar lam phod mdor zhag gcig bsdad/

sde pa rin po ches yar gsum bar skyel mar yang phebs/ der mi dmangs rnams la ma ṇi'i lung dang sems bskyed cig byas pa/ sde pa'i zhabs drung gis kyang gsan te chos 'brel gyi thog ma yin no/ / de nyin rwa bsgreng du sleb pa'i jo bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs rten rnams la gser chab sogs kyang zhus snga phyir dkar me snyan dar sogs rgyas pa 'bul thub cing*/

bar skor la brten pa'i gnas mjal yang shin tu zhib par byas/ tshogs su'ang chos 'brel dang gnas so so thams cad du yang chos kyi rnam grangs re bshad/ khyad par brag seng ge'i zhol rje btsun tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas chos 'brel zhig dgos zer ba la/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i gnad 'doms pa lam rim bsdus pa'i dbang du byas pa zhig bshad/ rgya dpe me thub ma rnams kyi rten mjal byas pas/ shān ti bas mdzad pa'i brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa sogs rgya dpe mang po'i gsham na/ bhaṅga la panṭi ta bhikṣi dī paṃ ka ra shī dzñānasyabusta kaṃ/ zhes pa 'dug pas jo bo rje nyid kyi phyag dper nges pa'i mos gus chen pos mchi ma 'khrug cing na bza' dang dri bzang la rin po che bsres pa sogs phul zhing smon lam mang du btab/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag gi rgyud kyi rgya dpe nas shog bu gnyis tsam rgya skad nyid du mgyogs par klogs shing*/ de rjes so sor phral nas bod skad bsgyur gyin bshad pas/ rwa bsgreng pa thams cad sngar mi che dgu thams cad la rten mjal phul zhing*/ sgra ba dang lo tsā bar btags pa mang po zhig rang byung na'ang*/ 'bru re 'bru gnyis klog pa tsam las mi 'dug pa ngo mtshar che zhes ngo bstod mang po byed kyin 'dugatshur lam lha chu rgyas pa nas lcags la thon te phu mdor bcag mal zhig bsdad/ sde pa yab yum drung du tshe bka' sogs dgongs bzhed bzhin phul/ sgrub gnas ser le ru zhag gsum tsam bsdad/ rje sangs rgyas yar byon gyi sku 'dra gsung byon ma la mchod pa bzang du bshams shing smon lam btab/ de na smon mkhar nas dpon sa'i drung sras yum bzhugs 'dug pa la'ang dgongs bzhed kyi chos 'brel 'dra phul/ slar rnam rgyal rab brtan nyid du sleb/ 'di skor gyi skabs shig tho rangs gnyid min dngos min la/ shes pa gsal zhing dwangs pa zhig gi ngang nas sa dang bar snang la lus dbyibs sna tshogs pa yod pa'i skye bo grangs med pa zhig 'gro ba zhig 'dugade dag dang lhan cig tu song bas lung ba gru gsum kha dog dmar po zhig gi dbus na/

shel gyi ri blos mi 'khyud pa zhig 'dug de nyid mchod rten bzo 'bras shin tu mtshar ba che chung ma nges pas go mtshams med par gtams pa zhig 'dug pa/ mchod rten re re la yang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku dpag tu med pa dang de thams cad kyang zhu ba zhu lan sogs chos kyi sgra di ri ri 'duganam mkha' nas me tog gi char 'bebs pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang po dang*/ phyogs bcu nas 'dus pa'i sems can grangs med pa mang po mchod pa byas kyin 'dug pas thams cad kyang mgrin gcig tu/ e yig la ni waṃ gnas te/ / rgyal ba kun gyi pho brang la/ / sangs rgyas grangs med bdun bcu gnyis/ / 'khor ni bye ba bye bas bskor/ / bde chen 'od dpag med pa'i zhing*/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pa mang po zhig 'don gyin 'dug pa/ tshig gi 'phro rnams brjed nas thal/ ri 'di ci yin dris pas mchod rten dpal yon can yin zer/ 'di skabs dpal jo nang du bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis lhag bsam rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas rgyu gang yod bsgril nas/ sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo la zhig gsos bgyis pa grub tu nye ba'i skabs yin pa 'dug pas de la lta ba yin nam sems/ bka' drin mnyam med mkhan rin po che de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i thabs su nang rten bzhengs pa'i tshe/ gser mang tsam zhes 'bul rgyu byung zhing*/ de min rten bzhengs pa sogs ma grub pas de nyid la dmigs pa yin/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gcig kyang bzhengs/ mchod rten zhig gsos kyang grub shin tu che ba byung*/ nam gung mi rnams gnyid du song ba'i skabs/ rgyang nas shing gzhog pa dang zangs brdung ba dang sbud pa'i sgra sogs di ri ri yod pa lan mang du byung ba dang*/ rab gnas mdzad 'dug pa'i skabs su'ang 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i ya mtshan che ba rang byung 'dugade rjes slob dpon rin po che'i phyag dam thams cad du nga ni rang res zhig gsos kyi bya ba grub pa yin pas da sgos myur du 'gro ba yin gsung ba 'byor byung ba phyi mtha' ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i gsung du byung*/

'di skabs dpal stag lung rin po cher blo sbyong gi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa zhig dgos phebs pa ltar ngag thog nas don bdun ma'i khrid kyi steng du gzhan rnams tshang bar byas/ yig rnying rnam grangs shin tu mang ba'i lung rnams kyang phul/ dngos kyis kyang sku rags ma'i skor gyi lung yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ nyams len khrid tshul gyi snying po rnams zhus/ de mtshams gling gi gzims spyil du bskyas shing*/ sprul pa'i sku rin po cher thang pa rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi 'phros dang nye bar mkho ba'i lung chos kyang mang du zhus shing*/ gtso bor stag lung bka' brgyud nyid kyi rang bzhed nā ro chos drug shin tu smin pa sogs stag lung bka' brgyud rang dang 'brel ba'i dbang rjes gnad mang bar zhus shing snga phyir dam pa mchog 'di la lung bka' chos mang ba thob/ gtso bor dgongs bzhed ltar bde mchog lwa ba bcu gsum ma/ sdom 'byung rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po don zhags gzungs grwa lnga rnams kyi dbang sogs dang*/ mar rngog yab sras kyi bzhed pa las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang 'brel ba'i chos rnam grangs shin tu mang ba la/ rngog lugs dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsre 'pho'i skor dang*/ gur gyi srog shing*/ 'grel pa bka' yang*/ gur ṭīka gzer chen/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ rgyud ṭī ka mgar gyis mdzad pa/ gdan bzhi'i rgya gzhung rnams dang*/ rgyud 'grel rngog ston thogs med grags pas mdzad pa rnams kyi lung dang*/ mā ya dang gdan bzhi'i 'khrid tshul man ngag gi yi ge rnams kyi lung sogs dang ras chung snyan brgyud rnying pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ gsang 'dus rim lnga mar lugs kyi 'khrid tshul rgyas pa dang*/ bu ston rin po che'i khrid yig dang*/ gdams ngag nag khrid kyi dpe bum yongs rdzogs dang*/ rim lnga spyod bsdus sogs 'phags skor gyi rgya gzhung rnams dang*/

'grel chen sgron gsal gyi lung*/ dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs dang gzhung drug sogs lung gi skor yongs su rdzogs pa sogs rnam grangs mang ba rang phul zhing*/ bka' las gsang 'dus rim lnga la khrid yig mang po 'dug na'ang*/ tshig don gnyis ka mar lugs gtsang sang nge ba mi snang bas brda' don gnyis ka mar lugs kho na yin pa gsal la cha tshang ba zhig rtsoms shig ces/ bka' gnang phebs pa la brten te/ rim lnga smar khrid gdan rdzogs kyi khrid yig rnying rnams la 'thor thabs su gnas shing 'ga' zhig gab pa dang mi gsal ba'i tshul du yod pa de gsal zhing ma 'khrugs par bsgrigs pa 'di brtsams pa/ phyis byung mar ba'i rjes 'brang du khas len pa mang po zhig gi sa na ham pa spyi brtol kho na la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum bzang bar rtsi ba 'dug pa rnams ltar na/ kho bo'i 'di tsam yang bstan pa la cung zad bya ba byas pa yin par sems/ de ltar zla ba gnyis kyi bar du snga gro nyi shar la yang dgon gzims khang du sleb par byas gzims khang de nyid kyi nyi ma ma bzhud kyi bar sku gzhogs de nyid du bka' chos zhu 'bul rnams bgyis shing*/ de mtshams gzims spyil du tshogs chen la nyin re bzhin rjes gnang re ma chag pa dang*/ snying po don gsum gyi khrid dang*/ bde mchog lha lnga'i smin byed kyis sgo phye ste/ shangs chos yongs su rdzogs pa gzhung bka' so so dang 'brel bar bsgrubs/ de grol mtshams su so so'i 'dod chos la chos thun gnyis gsum re 'chag med du byung zhing*/ don gnyer 'ga' shas la brtag gnyis kyi zhib bshad rtsa ba tshig gcig kyang ma lus pa rdzogs par bshad/ grog khar yang grub pa'i dbang phyug gi zhabs drung du padma bhai ra ba dang dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i rjes gnang sogs dang rdo rje phur pa'i chos skor sogs rnam grangs mang ba thob/ dngos kyis kyang chos than thun dgongs bzhed ltar phul/

de nas slar yang rnam rgyal rab brtan du bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du zla gcig skor bsdad cing*/ rje ri bo che ba'i bka' 'bum dang 'brel ba'i byin rlabs rjes gnang rnam grangs mang ba dang*/ gu ru drag dmar nyang lugs kyi dbang dang lung bka' yongs rdzogs thob/ dngos kyis kyang sku tshe'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang brgya rtsa zhig phul zhing*/ khams pa dge slong gnyis kyis nan chags kyis bskul ba la brten te/ dbang mi bdun tsam la bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang zhig byas/ dus slob ma sta gon gyi gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi skabs de rang du/ srin lag g.yon nas khrag rang brdol du byung*/ 'di ltar bu yang phyis 'tshub pa'i ltas su ka byung*/ sog po'i rgyal brgyud dpon po kha dan bag dur yang*/ bla ma bzang dgu la nor lha'i rjes gnang rang ched kyis zhu yin 'dug pa/ nged la yang dzambha la ser po'i rjes gnang zhig dgos zer ba bzhin byas/ khong dang lhan du hor stong pa'i rgyal bus kyang rjes gnang de zhus song*/ dpon po kha dan gyi rgyal mo rgan pa na ba yin pas khong gi ru khrod du yong dgos tshul nan chags byed kyin 'dug na'ang ye ma phyin/ kho rang yang dpal de bzhin gshegs pa stag lung pa 'di/ nged gnam gyis bskos pa'i rgyal po dkar po a ba dan gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin/ nged sog po rnams la sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba yin pa/ de'i yang bla ma khyed nyid yin 'dug pas thugs dam skyabs 'og tu 'jug dgos zer gus pa chen po byed kyin 'dugahor zla dgu pa'i nyi shu gsum la rje btsun dpal stag lung pa chen po brtan bzhugs dang bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i yon rnams phul/ sems can gyi mgon skyabs la dgongs te zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba btab/ lo shas de ka byed dgos gsung zhal gyis bzhes/ nang par nyi shu bzhi la dar la brgyud nas ku rur sleb/ brag nag gi ri khrod du 'bod mi byung ba ltar phyin zhag gsum bsdad/

de mtshams nyan por yang phyin/ nye skor gyi yul chung thams cad du sgo skor la phyin pas yig drug gi 'gro don che bar byung*/ khyad par nyan po'i gtsug lag khang du ma ṇi'i lung byas pa dang*/ shar pa 'bum pa mjal ba'i tshe mi tshogs shin tu che bar byung zhing*/ de dag tu me tog gi char yang bsnyon med du babs/ lhun grub rdzong du zhag gsum bsdad cing*/ zhal ngo rnams la dgongs bzhed kyi chos 'dra phul/ sum 'phrang du phyin dus ra lung pa'i cog grwa ba dpon slob rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig chos 'brel du byas/ dpal glang ri thang du mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pas 'bod mi nan can yod pa bzhin sleb/ glang thang rang du zhag nyi shu skor bsdad cing gtsug lag khang du snga dro rjes gnang re dang*/ gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun la paṇa chen gser mdog can pa nas brgyud pa'i skor gyi shangs chos yongs rdzogs dang*/ dgongs mo skya btsun tshogs chen pa la theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong dang smar khrid sogs bshad cing*/ bla brang du so so'i 'dod chos zhu ba shin tu mang bar byung*/ bar bar du nye 'khor gyi dpon chung 'dra dang grong tsho thams cad la phyin/ khyad par khrom chen po la sems bskyed bsdus pa dang ma ṇi'i lung dang khrom dbang rnams byas pa'i skabs/ khrom mi tshogs shin tu che bas ma ṇi bskul mkhan gcig gis ma 'khul bar tsho bzhir bgos te/ ma ṇi bskul mkhan bzhi byed dgos par byung*/ sems bskyed kyi skabs me tog gi char bsnyon med du babs pa'i me tog che ba rnams ni phug ron tsam thams cad gyis mthun snang du grub pa mthong*/ 'di skabs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub yig na yod pa bzhin bud med 'ga' zhig gi dpral ba dang 'khur tshos kyi steng na g.yu drung ris dmar ser g.yon du drag tu 'khor ba'i rnam pa nam yang mthong*/ tho rangs shig paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po shākya mchog ldan gyi ye shes kyi sku'i snang cha zhu lan dang bcas pa gsal ba zhig byung ste/

'di'i lo rgyus zhu lan gyi rdo rje'i tshig 'grel pa man ngag sogs logs su bkod yod pas der shes par bya'o/ / grub rgyal nas 'bod mi nan can byung ba bzhin phyin/ chos rje don grub pa'i drung dang nang so zhal ngo rnams la brda don gsal ba'i khrid/ tshe dbang rjes gnang sogs rnam grangs mang ba dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs shig kyang bgyis shing*/ dgon pa'i gtsang khang gsar bzhengs la rab gnas shig kyang byas/ rdzong mdun gyi mthil der khrom dbang zhig byas pa 'phan yul stod kyi mi phal cher tshogs shing thams cad kyang dad pa che bar 'dug pas nges 'byung la bskul ba dang las 'bras kyi chos bshad pa'i tshe mchi ma 'byin pa dang*/ yid 'gyur ba'i sdig pa sna re spong ba dang*/ dge ba sna re sgrub pa'i dam bca' byed mi mang bar byung*/ de nas glang thang du sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi gzhung shlau ka stong gi tshad tsam pa/ rong zom chen po chos bzang gis bsgyur ba'i dpe lag tu 'byor/ mthong ba tsam gyis snga gong yun ring sbyong myong ba ltar brjed gsos pa 'dra ba zhig la yid dga' bas khyab pa zhig byung*/ de nas skyor mo lung nas 'bod mi gnang byung ba ltar lam du zhugs/ gro sar rwa lo'i thugs dam gandho la sogs gro sa'i rten rnying pa rnams mjal/ gro sa'i la la 'thon yab tu sleb/ de nas snga bar langs te ra tsag mjal bar phyin/ rten thams cad la yang snyan dar phul zhing*/ khyad par rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la kha yig 'byar ba'i snyan dar shin tu mang ba phul/ dri bzang dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi me tog gtor gsol ba mang du btab/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags cung zad byung*/ skyor mo lung du grub thob brgyad cu'i zhal thang gsar bzhengs la rab gnas bgyis/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid dang tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang sogs dgongs bzhed kyi chos rnams phul rjes/
