ra sa 'phrul snang du khor tsam phyin ma ṇi ba dung dkar 'brug sgras/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i sku brnyan gser zangs las bsgrubs pa dang*/ bka' 'gyur yang byed tsam bzhengs grub 'dug pa de rnams la rab gnas dgos zer ba ltar rab gnas 'bring po zhig byas/ jo bo shākya mu ni'i sku mdun gyi khyams khra der bka' 'gyur gyi zhus dag la byon pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyis tsam zhig dang gzhan yang dkon gnyer ba sogs kun bsgril nyis brgya tsam la skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dmigs pa rnams bsdus pa'i lugs ltar dang lam gyi spy-i chings zhib mor bshad pas mi dmangs rnams la dad pa'i gsos 'debs tsam byas/ de na yod pa'i dge bshes rnams nged cag rtag tu lam rim gyi bshad pa byed pa yin yang sngar mtha' ma chod pa'i blo bskyed ji snyed cig byung zhes gzengs bstod mang po byed/

po ṭa la'i 'jam dpal gshin rje gdong drug gi li ma chos rgyal mes ag tshoms kyi thugs dam rten ngo mtshar can de nyid la snyan dar bcu tsam phul zhing gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ hrīḥṣtī yi ge nyer gsum pa'i sgra lhang lhang ba lan gsum tsam rna bar tshor bar chad 'ga' zhig bzlog pa'i ltas kyang shar/ 'di gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba'i sku 'dra yin/ skyid shod nas sde pa g.yul rgyal drung lan gcig mos gus che rab yod pa'i khungs kyang mdzad/ bar skabs 'dir dad pa log ge ba dang zhal mdzes mtshon yod tsam la zhe sun ne ba dang co 'dri se ba kho na mdzad/ ngas kyang co 'dri'i lan che ba re byas/ yer pa nas kyang zem me ba kho na mdzad/ skyid shod dga' ldan pa rang la rten 'brel gal che 'dra sgrig rgyu yod na'ang*/ de ka'i stabs nas ye ma 'grigastag lung pa tsho na re/ gzi 'bring rgyud la pho skyes dpa' bo mo skyes mkha' 'gro zer ba la/ ngas pho skyes de 'dra mo yin/ mo skyes rang de ci 'dra byas pa'i bzhad gad kyang yod/ yer ba nas dpon sa'i drung rang de chos phyogs srid phyogs gnyis ka 'brel med phyin ci log kun gyis gzigs pa de yin/ pha ming la mi phan pa la khyim sa brlag pa chos mdzad nas kyang blo gtong sa nor ba/ rang gi zhal ngo skyes bu dam pa tsho la mi dad pa/ gdol thabs tsho la mos zhen skyes pa de ka lags mod/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sgugs la sdod ga na yod pa/ de nas tshur lam shun du zhabs drung gdung brgyud dang mjal/ tshe dbang dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ tshas snar zhag gcig gi sar rgyang nas bla chen rin po che snye thang chos rdzong nas ched kyis 'phrad par phebs byung*/ dpon slob rnams la dgongs bzhed ltar lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi yig lung rnams rdzogs par phul/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes brgyad la gzhis ka gong dkar du sleb/ tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin slob dpon rin po che chos kyi dbyings su sku thim pa'i gnas tshul skyel mi sleb/

de 'phral thos mchod du ra ba smad pa'i grwa tshang dang*/ gong dkar chos sde/ khu spe/ skyed tshal 'og sogs nye skor gyi dgon sde rnams su mang ja 'gyed bcas dang*/ dgongs rdzogs thugs dam bskul ba bgyis shing ra ba smad dang chos sder snga phyir mang ja 'gyed bcas grangs mang bar bgyis/ de 'phral nas stod phyogs myur shad 'gro rtsis yod na'ang*/ 'gro ba'i bsam pa btang ba nas rlung ltas log cing rmi lam du'ang da res ma phyin pa legs pa'i ltas byung ba nas/ yid kyis bsams pas kyang rang gi chas rang gis zos pa tsam gyis dgongs rdzogs su 'gro rgyu cang mi 'dug pas rdzas gang yod dge 'dun gyi sde so sor mchod pa la song na legs par yang shes mod/ phyis kyi sa skya'i gdung brgyud la 'das grongs byung tsa na/ shul mchod mkhan zhal ngo des rang gis rang la 'bul ba rgya chen rang rgyag pa'i srol ni 'dugagazhan ni de 'dra ga la srid/ nged kyis de mtshams gang ci thams cad du a khu'i drung dang kun dga' chos dbyings par zhib 'then bslab ston byas shing*/ dgongs rdzogs kyi tshogs dbu la gtso bor brag stod nas rje btsun bla ma rin po che spyan gang 'drongs dang*/ gal srid spyan ma 'drongs na/ rje dam pa'i bu chen du yang ni 'dugaslob dpon rin po che de nyid kyis kyang chos 'brel cung zad gsan 'dug pa/ bstan 'dzin rin po che spyan 'dren zhus na legs pa dang*/ da lta 'phral du gang yod rnams slob dpon rin po che de nyid rang gi mkhyen pa dang thugs rje las phyung ba yin pas thams cad gtong dgos tshul zhib rgyas su glengs nas myur shad du khong rnams brdzangs/ 'di skabs dgongs rdzogs kyi dngos gzhi ri khrod chen po jo mo nang du chos lung bsam sdings byang chen so so'i dgon lag dang bcas pa rnams tshogs pa'i so sos kyang dkyil 'khor tha dad pa zhal phye zhing thugs dam bskul/ tshogs dbur rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa spyan 'dren zhus kyang phebs ma thub pas gral dbu la bsngau ba gnang bar bstan 'dzin rin po che zhag gcig spyan 'dren zhus 'dugabasngo brten gtso bor brag stong du bla ma dam pa'i drung du phul zhing*/

dgon lag dang bcas par mang ja 'gyed bcas kyi sku skal phud rnams phul/ grwa tshang chen mo bya rgod gshongs sa skya ngam ring bzang ldan rnams su mang ja 'gyed sogs kyi sku skal jo nang nas bgyis/ ngor snar thang gangs can bkra shis lhun po zha lu gnas dgon rnams su byang chen dang snar thang na yod pa rnams gyi steng nas lhag ma ma lus par btang*/ gser mdog can du gser mdog can rang na yod pa rnams kyi steng nas lugs mthun du bsgrubs shing*/ dpal 'khor chos sde rtse chen chos sde dga' ba gdong gnas rnying sogs nyang gi chos sde dgon gnas che phra rnams su bsam sdings na yod pa rnams kyi steng nas song ba kun bsgril stod smad thams cad du bsdoms pas nas 'gyed la khal khri tsho phyed gnyis tsam song*/ gzhan rnams des mtshon/ rim pas dbus yar 'brog gi dgon gnas rnams su yang rang re la bltos pa'i gang grag bgyis shing*/ dge sbyor thams cad kyang thugs yid dbyer med du bsre ba'i ngang nas bgyis pa'i khungs byas/ gtso bor bdag nyid bla na med pa ye shes mchog dam pa thob pa de'i tshe bla ma'i thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su gang bar bya yi/ gzhan du dam pa'i chos tshig gcig gi drin lan yang bskal par lon par ga la 'gyur/ 'dir smras pa/ 'di na tshogs gnyis gser gyi ri bo'i spor/ / nam yang chags pa'i 'dab chags rgyal po rol/ / mi mkhas chen po'i las la chung ngu'i 'bras/ / shes ldan thabs la mkhas pas rgya cher spel/ / de nas zla ba de nyid kyi nang du zhal ngo so sor dgongs bzhed kyi chos rnam grangs mang ba tsam phul/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la tshogs dge 'dun sgang ba'i mkhan chen rin po che shākya rin dbang gis gtso bor nan tan du mdzad pa'i don dang*/ gzhan yang gsol ba bdebs pa mang po'i ngor gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras tshugs par byas/ 'di skabs chos zhu ba rab smad pa shas che ba'i dge 'dun rang mang ba dang*/

bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang rab dang bcas pa byung zhing*/ khrid dmigs bshad pa mtha' chod dang bcas pa rgyas nges pa byas/ snang gsum skabs bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang*/ rgyud gsum gyi skabs yig sna drug cu/ po ti dmar chung sogs kyi lung bklags shing*/ dgun nyi ma thung ba'i stabs lung rgya chen po rang ma song*/ rgyu dbang la dbang cha sum cu tsam byung zhing*/ yab bka' yum bka' gnyis ka'ang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor cho ga rgyas pas bzhengs thub/ dam tshig gi chos skor song mtshams rgyud gsum gyi dmigs pa ma tshugs gong der/ zhabs drung bkra shis stobs rgyas nas bka' bkod nan chags kyis/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po'i rgyal sras dang*/ mkhyen brtse lags gnyis car bstud mar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i tshogs dbu la yongs na ma yongs yin gsung byung bas tshes dgu'i snga chos grol nas lcags zam rtser phyin/ bkra shis stobs kyi sras che ba rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po mchan/ rgyal bu sku bgres pa bla ma'i drung dang yang mjal zhing dgongs rdzogs kyi sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs/ dril bu'i tshangs mgo bral ba zhig byung bas dmigs pa'i bar chad du song yid mi bde ba zhig dang rtog pa'ang za ba zhig byung ste/ phyis zhabs drung stobs drung rang myur du zhabs pad mi brtan pa'i rten 'brel du go / dgongs rdzogs grol 'phral myur shad yongs pas tshes bcu'i dgongs chos ma chag tsam thub/ 'di skabs lam 'bras kyi cha lag dbang byin rlabs thams cad rdzogs par song*/ ra ba smad nas drung chen 'phrin las dpal 'byor ba'i dgongs bzhed ltar sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang rgya gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa byas shing*/ zhu mkhan zhabs drung zhal ngo rnams kyis gtso mdzad pa'i 'phyong rtse dkar phibs su shong mi shong tsam byung*/ snga phyir bde mchog lū hi pa bde mchog bong zhal can bde mchog sdom 'byung*/

bde mchog sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gsum ma/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs dang*/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i khrid tshul shin tu smin pa/ gzhung bka' nyi shu dang 'brel ba'i shangs chos rnams cha tshangs ba dang*/ rgyud sde lnga gcig tu bsgril ba'i dbang bskur rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i steng nas/ gong ma zhal ngo rnams gtso bor phebs pa'i dbang zhu mi brgya tsam la legs par bsgrubs pa mchod gtor bsham lugs bum pa 'jog lugs tshun chod dang dbang gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs shangs lugs rang gi phyag len gtsang mar byas/ lam 'bras grol mtshams su de nyid bcu'i pha rol tu son pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug dge slong ye shes dbang po spyan drangs te/ chos 'brel gyi thog mar gu ru zlum po bzhi'i dbang zhus/ ye shes phab pa'i dus su sems la bde nyams chen po zhig shar/ de nub rmi lam du'ang sgrub yig nas bshad pa'i ltas rnams byung*/ sngar rten 'brel log pa de cung zad sor chud par snang*/ de nas rdo rje phur pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs nas dbang bskur stsal ba'i sta gon gyi nub rmi lam du skas ring po zhig la 'dzeg gin 'dug pas skas gdang re re la rdog pa 'jog pa dang dga' ba gcig dga' ba gnyis zhes pa nas dga' ba nyi shu tham pa'o zhes pa dang skas mgor sleb/ de na rdo rje gnod sbyin yin zer ba zhig 'dug pa la byin rlabs zhus pa zhig rmis/ drag po sgrol dbang zhus pa'i nub brag rdzong shin tu btsan pa zhig na 'dug pa'i rmi ltas shig byung*/ mthu btang sogs sbyor ba ngan pa byir bzlog pa'i ltas su go / gsang ba 'dus pa 'gos lugs rnying ma sa skya pa'i rje btsun dkar po rnam gsum yang brgyud pa la bzhugs pa'i chos shin tu dkon pa deng sang sa zhen che che mo kun gyis kyang rtsad ma chod pa de yang bzhugs kyin 'dug pas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor steng nas dbang rdzogs bar zhus/

lha ngo ston pa mdzad skabs dmigs pa shin tu gsal bas gzhal yas khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mngon sum du mthong ba snyam byed pa byung*/ phur bsrungs kyi rjes gnang sogs chos tshan thor bu 'ga' shas kyang thob/ dpon slob rnams la sa lugs kyi bde mchog lhan skyes kyi rjes gnang zhig dgos phebs pa ltar phul/ de nas zhal ngo rnams dang rin po che lha rtse ba sogs kyang karma pa mjal bar phebs song ba/ de bar zhag bcu skor zhig shin tu 'gol zhing kha 'don 'phel ba skyid par byung*/ 'di skabs ra ba smad pa rnams la gnas bstan bcu drug gi rjes gnang dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug bla ma rin po che ye shes dbang po dang*/ dge slong rdor grags/ gser gling nas bka' bcu pa ye rgyal ba sogs chos sde ba mang dag zhig la bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang*/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang*/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi bka' gtad/ lho nub mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs phul/ / 'di nyid dge slong rin po che'i drung du/ bka' gdams glegs bam spus gtsang ba zhig 'bul mkhan byung ba sogs rten 'brel legs par byung 'dugaskyed tshal 'og nas chos rje grub thob pa bde mchog lū hi pa'i dbang dang lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi lung zhu bar byon byung bzhed don ltar bgyis/ yar rgyab nas de gong yang 'bod mi 'thangs len lan kha yar nan ci che che rang byung ba dang*/ 'di skabs skyid ru nas bgres pa 'bod mir gnang ba ltar/ hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bdun la skyid shongs su sleb tsam byas/ zhal ngo rnams la dgongs bzhed ltar tshe bka' dang*/ mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang*/ ras chung lugs kyi tshe khrid mgyogs khrid rnams byas/ de'i sang chos brgyad la lhun grub lha rtser 'byor/ sdod sa phun tshogs bkod kyi steng der byas/ sleb 'phral nas tshe bka' sogs kyi zhal ngo'i dgongs bzhed than thun dang*/

zhag shas nas grwa thang nas bla chen rin po che dpon slob rnams kyang phebs shing*/ rim pas 'dod chos zhu mkhan phyogs nas kyang rnam grangs mang ba rang 'dus/ gdung bu dang chos rdzong sogs nye skor de nyid la bzhugs pa'i chos zhu ba yang mang ba dang so so nas chos 'brel 'dod pa sogs kyang shin tu mang bar byung*/ gang ltar 'di skabs sleb nas zla gcig tsam gyi bar chos thun bzhi lnga ma chag pa dang*/ de mtshams nas zla ba bzhi'i bar du nyin re bzhin chos thun bcu gnyis re ma chag pa dang*/ mang dus su chos thun bco lnga bcu drug re yod pa'ang mang du byung zhing*/ bla chen rin po che'i bzhed chos kyi gtso bo shangs chos yongs rdzogs dang*/ ngor chen nas brgyud pa'i lam 'bras cha lag dang bcas yin pa 'dug pa bzhin gtso bor bsgrubs pa yin la/ gzhan so so'i don gnyer rnams la chos bshad pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa ni/ lam 'bras dang 'brel bar brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed/ slob ma rjes bzung*/ kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi rgyu dbang*/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i rgyu dbang yab/ bka' lus dkyil gyi dbang dang*/ yum bka' lus dkyil gyi byin rlabs/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ yi ge brgya pa/ aṣta rnams kyi bzlas lung*/ lam zab phyi nang*/ bir srung phyi nang*/ dbang bzhi ngo sprod/ brda don gsal ba/ sgrub pa lung byin sogs dang*/ snang gsum gyi skabs zab mo mdo lnga'i lung*/ rgyud gsum nas bzung ste/ lam 'bras glegs bam dang*/ thun mong ba'i yig sna bdun te yig sna drug cu/ po ti dmar chung*/ pod nag ma yongs rdzogs/ po ti dmar chung du ma 'dus pa yig rnying phra mo bzhi bcu tsam/ gzhung bshad smar ma rnams kyi lung*/ bsam mi khyab dang*/ phyag chen yi ge med pa'i byin rlabs/ lam skor phyi ma rnams kyi lung khrid/ nai gu chos drug dang phyag chen ga'u ma tshar gnyis/ lam 'khyer gyi khrid/ mkha' spyod dkar dmar gyi khrid zhal shes ma/

'chi med kyi khrid/ gzer gsum gyi khrid/ bdag med ma'i nang khrid/ su kha chos drugade dag dang 'brel bar bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang rgyas pa sogs/ chos drug bka' bcu/ phyag chen bka' lnga/ mkha' spyod bka' lnga/ mgon po bka' lnga/ 'chi med 'khrul 'khor gyi byin rlabs/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar yongs rdzogs/ mgon po'i skor ma gtogs pa'i shangs chos kyi po ti chen po gnyis tsam gyi lung*/ bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang*/ gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs/ gshed mar lha lnga/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad bskor/ ma hā mā ya rngog lugs/ gshed dmar bcu gsum ma/ mi 'khrugs pa jo bo lugs kyi dbang la sogs pa dang*/ snying po don gsum/ ras chung lugs kyi tshe khrid/ rtsa dbu ma'i khrid ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ nag po rim bzhi/

lū hi pa'i khrid bsdu ba gsum ldan/ 'jigs byed kyi khrid rwa rtse sems 'dzin dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi pa/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i hūṃ khrid bzhi/ ma hā mā ya'i khrid/ gshed dmar rnal 'byor bzhi rim dang*/ spros med kyi khrid/ rje btsun rin po che kun dga' grol mchog gi bka' 'bum po ti bzhi yongs rdzogs dang*/ nged rang gis brtsams chos po ti bzhi/ ku ru kulle dang rnal 'byor ma'i skor gyi po ti gcig/ ri chos skor gsum sogs yang dgon pa'i gsung po ti gnyis/ zhang tshal pa'i gsung po ti gcigaskyes rabs brgya rtsa rgyan gyi me togabyams chos sde lnga rnams kyi lung*/ mdo sde rgyan dang rgyud bla ma'i gnad 'doms kyi bshad pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud bdun/ 'phags pa yab sras kyi gzhung bdun/ 'grel chen sgron gsal/ 'gos lo tsā ba'i stong thun chen mo dang shog ril gsum/ rim lnga mar lugs nag khrid kyi yig sna nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi lung*/ brtag gnyis dang bde mchog rtsa rgyud la sogs pa rgyud 'ga' yar gyi lung*/ de dag gi bshad 'doms don mthong ba dang bcas pa lan kha yar/ lū hi smad lnga/ dril bu gzhung gsum/ nag po gzhung drugaphag mo gzhung drugami dbang chos gsum/ mai tri mkha' spyod kyi rgyud gzhung gsum/ ma hā mā ya la ku ku ri ba'i chos bdun/ 'gar gyi ḍī ka dang rngog pa'i bshad tshoms chen mo'i steng du rgya 'grel gyi legs bshad bsnan pa'i bshad bgros rgyas pa dang*/ de'i man ngag gi yi ge bcu gcig ma gcig gi gcod khrid/ birwa ba'i gshed dmar gyi gzhung brgyad/ glo bo lo tsā ba'i gshed dmar gyi yig cha phal che ba'i lung*/ mtshal min pa'i dge 'dun thams cad dus 'khor jo lugs kyi dbang zhu bar byon byung ba gzhan yang don gnyer shin tu mang ba dang bcas bzhi brgya tsam la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/

gzhan yang sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid dam po'i phyag len dang bcas pa shin tu smin pa dang*/ dus zhabs snyan brgyud/ sha wa ri ba'i gzhung chung*/ sbyor drug brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ kun spangs chen po dang*/ chos rje phyogs pas mdzad pa'i sbyor drug gi yig cha phal che ba dang*/ gzhan yang dus 'khor bsdus rgyud/ dbang mdor bstan/ rgyud phyi ma/ don dam bsnyen pa/ 'jam dpal gyi lta ba 'dod mdor bstan/ 'grel chen dri med 'od/ rdo rje snying 'grel la sogs pa'i lung*/ sa lugs kyi mkha' spyod ma skor gsum dang*/ dpyal lugs phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs/ thun mong gi gdams pa drug dang*/ khyad par gyi gdams pa bcu gcig gi khrid/ dmar po skor gsum/ rnam rgyal 'joms/ pu ṭa sogs rjes gnang zur bka' mang po dang*/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho la sgrub thabs nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe drug ste so so'i rjes gnang du rgya gzhung yongs rdzogs kyi lung*/ bsam gtan sgang gi chos rje rang gis kyang chos mang du zhus shing*/ khong gi grwa btsun yod bdag pho mo sogs brgya bud skor zhig la bde mchog 'khrul spong gi dbang bskur zhig byas/ 'di dag gi bar skabs su rdze btsun dpal stag lung ba chen po'i rnam thar dang*/ grub chen buddha nā tha'i rnam thar/ gsang 'dus rim lnga 'gos lugs kyi khrid yigasgrol ma 'byung ba'i dkyil chogabla chen rin po ches bskul ba ltar dril bu rim lnga'i khrid yig sogs kyang brtsams/ yul tsho so so nas yig drug gi bzlas lung dang*/ sems bskyed zhu ba sogs kyang shin tu mang bar byung*/ de yang nged ma sleb gong du rten bzhengs kyi 'tshub cha dge skyon cher byung song ba dang*/ khyad par bzo bo bal bo 'ga' shas shi zhing na mkhan gsum gsum bzhi bzhi rgyun mi 'chad pa byung 'dug pa/ nged sleb nas zhag gsum tsam nas bzo 'phro rnams la bgegs skrad dang bsrung ba bzab ma zhig byas de 'phral brgya sgo'i 'gag tu mdzo gcig shi 'dugabazo bo na ba sogs 'tshub cha thams cad de nas zhi/

rdo rje gdan pas mdzad zer ba'i bstod pa'i go rim ltar bzhed pa mdzad 'dug pas/ nged sleb mtshams na slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i sku bzhengs dang 'griga'aphran bu bsgyur bkod dgos pa rnams kyi kha ta'ang zhib par bgyis/ dbyar nyi ldog gong du gtso bo la rab gnas thub tu re ba tsam byung na'ang*/ gtso bo'i sku rgyan la gser zho phyed nyis brgya tsam song zer ba'i bzo khyad phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ dbu rgyan gyi rgyal ba rigs lnga g.yu byang la brko ba sogs bzo gnas zhib grags pas de bzhin ni ma grub/ de bar du chos kyi 'gro phan shin tu che bar byung*/ lam 'bras grol nas mi ring bar gzungs bzhugs kyi gzungs sgril ba sogs kyi bkod pa byas shing zla phyed tsam la grub/ rten bzhengs gtos ches bas de nas kyang gzungs bzhugs 'bul ran gyi bar la rgyang tsam 'dug pa dang*/ ston smad du song bas 'gol bar byung bas bde mchog dang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa kha gso 'dra byed kyin bdun phrag gsum mtshams dam par byas/ 'di dus sngags chos rnam par dag pa 'phel ba'i dga' ston du grub thob mi dra ā nanda'i gsang yum yin snyam pa mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis dngos su a ru ra'i 'bras bu chen po snyim pa kha sbyor du cung mi shong ba zhig dang gzhan 'ga' yang byin byung ba/ sngon rje grol mchog la mkha' 'gros stsal ba de dang 'dra bar byung*/ de'i khu bcud mang du 'thungs pas rkang pa shin tu na ba'i rgyun de 'phral dragagazhan yang gzhi nad mang du byang*/ de nas kun dga' dpal bzang la bstan/ de min yun ring du su la yang ma bstan no/ / de skabs yon bdag gi sar yang rgyal po'i 'tshub che ba 'dug pa dang*/ nged rang la'ang gzhan gyis byad ltas che ba zhig byung ba nas de la dmigs te rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi drag po'i sbyin bsreg cig byas/ byi lo lo dus kyi thad du rtags kyang gsal bar byung*/

de mtshams nas rim pas gzungs sogs kyang phul zhing*/ zhag po bcu bzhi la gzungs bzhugs kyang legs par grub/ zhal gser 'bul ba sogs la yang rgyun ring du thogs pa dang*/ de nas zla gcig tsam 'gor ba 'dug pa nas/ thog mar bgegs mi 'jug pa'i bgegs skrod rab gnas byed dgos 'dug pa/ nub gcig thog mar rab gnas la yongs dus lha rten gyi gseb de thams cad mi'i gzugs can sna tshogs pas gang ba'i gtam 'bug 'bug byed kyin 'dugarang re'i sems la da ci nas rab gnas byed pa gsang rgyur 'dug pa la ma gsang ba de ma legs da ji ltar yong ngam bsam pa zhig byung*/ bgegs skrod dkyus ma zhig byas pas ye rang 'gro ma nyan der tshig pa zos mi thams cad phyi la bton/ yang stong pa'i gdeng dang yi dam gyi nga rgyal bskyed nas yungs kar gtor bas gzhan rnams yal/ birwa pa'i sku'i thang der 'od dkar po phub nyis 'gyur tsam zhig sgor re 'khyil ba dang*/ sku de yang 'phar ba'i snang ba dang 'di skad byed na khyod la zhag bdun gyi tshe las med de nas sde pa'ang 'chi khang pa 'di yang rlag par byas gtong zer ba 'od de'i dkyil nas sgra lhang lhang ba byung*/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi snyems pa'i ngang nas zhags pas bcings shing mtshon cha'i cher 'bebs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'od de'i dkyil du rdo rje 'phangs pas 'od de sil zhig pa dang da 'dir yong ri shi zer zhing nyen skad ci ring ba zhig rna bar byung*/ birwa pa'i sku 'dra'i dpung bar rdo rje'i shul te ma skyong gis sod/ slar bsrung ba dang rab gnas byas/ de phyin shin tu 'jam pa rang gi legs lam gyi sgo che bar byung*/ phyin chad rten 'di ngos nas bkra shis po yong bar thag chod pa nged kyis khas longs tshul sde pa rang la'ang zhus shing de phyin chad mngon gsal du phebs lo bcu lhag gi bar la gong 'phel du song ba de yin/ skabs 'dir dang chung ngu nan chags yong dgos tshul byung ba nas khor tsam phyin pa'i zhag po bzhi song*/

rje lo tsā bsod rgyam pa'i dgon pa bsam gtan gling mjal/ khong rang so so'i 'dod chos tshe dbang rjes gnang dang spyan ras gzigs kyi smar khrid sogs blo dang mthun par byas de 'khor mtshams chos rje shākya bstan 'dzin rgyal rtse nas ched gtad 'bod mir gnang byung zhing*/ rab gnas sogs kyi stabs zhag shas sgug dgos byung bas/ de bar du mgon pod me 'bar ma'i lung dang zhal gyi gdams ngag cha tshang*/ khyad par bde mchog nag po pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag rgyas pa sngags rim man ngag gi gnad bcu gnyis kyi khungs chod pa la brten dgos tshul nan chags mdzad kyin 'dug pas bka' rgya'i dus kyang grol/ bshad du rung tsam gyi mtshan ma'ang byung bas chos rje'i drung dang*/ gzhan gnyis de gsum la man ngag de dag rim gyis bshad/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la gtso bo rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyan gzims khang phun tshogs bkod du spyan 'dren mdzad pa'i rab gnas dang*/ de rjes su lha gzhan rnams kyang rim pas spyan drangs te/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i sa chog tshes gnyis dang sta gon gyi cho ga tshes gsum la byas/ de nyin gyi 'phros dang bzhi la dkyil 'khor khru bcu gnyis pa'i tshad du bzhengs/ bzhi'i nub bdag mdun tsam gyi sgrub mchod byas shing*/ rgyab chog tu tshogs pa dge 'dun sgang ba dpon slob thams cad phebs pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga mdzad/ dngos cag rnams kyis tshes lnga'i tho rangs snga ba nas sgrub mchod btsugs pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga mtha' rgyas rang du bsgrubs shing*/ dga' ston tshogs dang bcas pas srod yol gyi bar 'gor/ slar yang nang bar dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bsdus pa dang rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg gi cho ga lag len mtha' rgyas kyis lha rnams mnyes par byas/ de mtshams dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i cho ga yang byas/ zhag mang por skye bo che phra'i 'du 'tshogs mang pas shin tu g.yeng che bar byung zhing*/

tshogs dge 'dun sgang ba dpon slob thams cad la bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs shig byas/ lha sa mjal du 'gro rgyu'i dwags po skor mi shin tu mang ba rang zhig rten gsar bzhengs rnams kyang mjal bar byung zhing*/ bde yangs su khong rnams la ma ṇi'i lung sogs byas/ 'di skabs khri khang nas sde pa ma chen grwa lnga'i drung gshegs pa'i gnas tshul skyel mkhan yang byung*/ snga sor 'khor rang gsung pa bde'ang bden pa 'dugade skabs rab gnas kyi brel ba'ang chod cing yar klungs nas 'bod mi rnams kyang dus thog tu ma byung bas/ rgyal rtsi'i 'bod mi sogs dang stabs bstun pa'i gtsang phyogs la 'phral du 'gro ba'i rtsis byas pa yin na'ang*/ tshes bcu bzhi la yon mchod lhan du rnam rgyal du phebs zhag gsum tsam bsdad cing*/ 'obs gsar 'dru gnang ba la rab gnas shig kyang byas/ don gnyer 'ga' la mi g.yo bla med kyi dbang bskur zhig kyang bsgrubs/ slar yang yar lung nas 'bod mi nyin re bzhin yang gnyis gnyis gsum gsum bstud nas byung*/ bar 'dir chos rje bsod nams rab rgyas pa la rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs/ bla ma rin 'byung don yod grub pa'i tshar gsum khug pa rnams thugs 'dod ltar bgyis/ de nas lam du chas de grwa phyi rdzong du zhag gcig bsdad/ yar lung kyi gzhi bdag tsho'i bsu ba'i bkod pa mang du byung*/ mon mkhar rnam sras gling gi skyed tshal du nang so zhal ngo rnams la sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang phyag len 'bring po'i steng nas byas/ nang par snga bar dpon khang nas yar tsam na gzhis ka zhig 'dug pa der phyin/ sras mo chung chung gnyis kyi skra bcad/ tshe dbang zhig kyang byas/ phyug po dgon pa'i bla ma sa dmar ba chos zhu'i don du nged cag dang lhan cig yar lung phyogs su byon/ chos mang du gsan/ khong rang la snga mo lung bstan zhig yod pa dang yang mthun par byung gsung gin 'dug/

gtsang chung gling khar bkra shis rtse nas sde pa bsu bar phebs/ tshe chu 'bum par gnas gsar nas rje drung yang phebs/ bkra shis rtse'i chos sder bsu ba'i bkod pa gzab rgyas dang bcas sleb/ zhal ngo rnams su tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang*/ btsun gsar bla med gyi dbang ma thob pa rnams la thogs mar bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang zhig byas/ gzhan lū hi pa'i dbang cha bzhi/ dril bu pa'i dbang cha bzhi/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor steng nas nag po pa dbang cha brgyad de de rnams bgyis shing nyin gung so so'i 'dod pa'i khrid chos sna tshogs dang*/ spyi chos su theg pa chen po blo sbyong yongs rdzogs dang*/ shangs chos byin rlabs dang 'brel ba yongs rdzogs/ dril bu rim lnga'i khrid bshad pa dang bcas pa/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i lung ci rigs pa dang*/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ dgyes rdor rgyud gsum/ sdom gsum rab dbye sogs kyi lung dang*/ dgongs phyogs rags bsdus rnams la nag po rim bzhi dang*/ lū hi pa'i khrid dang*/ don gnyer 'ga' la sngags rim man ngag gi gnad chen bcu gnyis snyan brgyud ma rnams byas shing*/ nyi ma nub nas srod kyi cha la don gnyer mang dag la sgrol ma'i chos skor rgya gar nas gsar du bsgyur pa rnams bgyis pa 'di'i rim pa la/ slob ma rjes bzung*/ rig pa gtad pa/ slob ma sta gon/ dngos gzhi thun mong gi dbang*/ thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bzhi par bcas pa rnams la zhag re re byed pa dbang bskur nub bdun ma dang*/ he ru ka lha dgu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang sogs byin rlabs dang*/ rjes gnang mang po dang*/ rgyud kyi gzhung shing las 'byung ba rnal 'byor bzhi'i rdzogs rim rgyas pa dang*/ zur bkol man ngag shin tu zab pa rnams dang*/ rtsa rgyud rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i lung tsam bgyis/ yum bu bla mkhar mjal bar yang khor tsam phyin/

ltag gi ri sgang der skye bo 'du tshogs che ba la yig drug gi lung dang*/ tshur lam sa paṇa gyi chos khri'i steng nas/ gang blo ma'i byin rlabs de byas/ de nyin skyes pa gzhon nu dkar po gcig pha tshad nas chos nyan gyin 'dugami rtsa khams dwangs pa gzhan 'ga' res kyang mthong*/ de yar lha dngos su gda'/ tshogs pa thams cad la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba rgyas par bsgrubs/ rje lcags nang pa dpon slob tsho'ang nged 'phrad par phebs pa/ nai gu'i sgyu lus dbang mo che byed pa dang 'dzom nas nga zhu ba mdzad song*/ bar 'dir chos lung rab brtan nas chos mdzad byams rin pas yong dgos tshul nan chags mdzad pa ltar phyin/ khong dang thugs yid 'dre zhing skyid par byung bas zhag bzhi bsdad/ btsun gsar dang btsun gsar ma byed mkhan yang 'ga' yar byung*/ khong rang dpon slob dang yon bdag drag bsdus 'dra la bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang dngos sta sbrel ma dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs/ tshe dbang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang sogs byas/

sgrub chu'i chu mig gsar pa zhig 'dug pa la rab gnas shig la phyin/ dgun grang sgang de nyid la nas rnams la ljang ba dang snye ma thon 'bru chags pa tsam byung 'dugazhag bzhi song ba'i snga dro mi dmangs la tshe dbang zhig kyang byas/ yang bkra shis rtse'i chos sder rje drung gnas gsar pa'i drung dge bshes 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa la/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i bdag po dang bdag po chen po'i dbang phyag len rgyas pa dang bcas pa bsgrubs/ thob thang min kyang 'jig rten ngo srung gi dbang las sde pa yab sras kyang de la yod/ chos sde'i bde yangs chen mo der khrom dbang zhig dang*/ bsam yas pa'i rab 'byams pa ston pa grags pa sogs mang dag la thugs rje chen po'i smrar khrid sogs bshad/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la mkhar thog tu phebs sgo ltar phyin/ zhag bdun tsam bsdad cing tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ bde mchog gi dbang*/ dgongs bzhed kyi rjes gnang mang dag dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i smyung gnas/ sgrol dkar kyi tshe khrid sogs phul zhing*/ mchod gnas gnas brtan pa 'ga' shas la snying po don gsum gyi khrid cig byas/ mi dmangs rnams la yig drug sogs chos 'ga' re bshad cing*/ dpon g.yog sku 'khor sogs shin tu mang ba la thugs rje chen po'i smrar khrid cig kyang byas/ tshes bcu la g.yo ru khra 'brug mjal bar phyin/ de 'phral phyogs bzhi nas 'dus pa'i mi 'tshogs shin tu che ba rang byung ba nas nges 'byung gis rgyud bskul ba'i gtam las drangs te ma ṇi'i lung zhig bgyis/ de nyin pho brang sne'u gdong rtser sleb pa zhabs drung gdung brgyud dang mjal/ de'i sang nyin nas chos 'bul ba'i 'go tshugs shin tu thugs snang dag pa rang gnang*/ thog mar tshe dbang brgya tshar dang rjes gnang mang dag phul/ tshes bcu drug la rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ thog mar zhabs drung sras yum la dbang yongs su rdzogs pa zhig dang*/

de rjes dbang cha gnyis pan zhig byas/ de dag grol mtshams nas gzims khang po ṭa la zer ba'i 'tshom der zhal ngo rnams gtso bor phebs shing*/ gzhan yang don gnyer mang dag dang bcas pa'i dbang mi drug cu bdun cu la dpal rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum ste dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe lnga po'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang*/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs/ bde mchog nag po pa/ bde mchog lha lnga rnams kyi dbang dang*/ phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i khrid shin tu smin pa dang*/ nai gu'i khrid sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang yongs rdzogs/ mgon po zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi drug dam can chos kyi rgyal po rnams kyi rjes gnang*/ zhabs drung gdung brgyud sku rkyang du phyag bzhi pa'i gsang khrid lugs tha dad sna tshogs dang bcas pa sogs chos bka' rnam grangs mang bar phul/ tshogs chen pa'i tshogs pa rnams kyang 'phrad par phebs thams cad kyi chos 'brel zhus song*/ tshogs pa'i nang nas sa lugs pa gtso che ba rnams la sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang byas/ de skabs lo gsar gyi skabs dang 'dzoms pas gral dbur yang shog phebs pa ltar phyin/ bar skabs shig do sngon du 'bod mi nan che bar byung ba ltar zhag shas sdod rtsis kyi 'gro 'dod tsam na yod skabs/ byang stag lung du zhabs drung grog kha pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gtso bo la yong dgos tshul gyi 'bod mir dbon po skyabs grol 'byor pas/ do sngon du zhag gcig las sdod skabs ma byung*/ sleb pa'i nyin mo nyid dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dbang dang*/ tshe rta sbrags ma sogs zhal ngo rnams su bzhed kyi chos dang*/ rtse thang gi dge 'dun phal cher zhig 'dus pa la sman bla'i rjes gnang sogs dang*/ gzhan yang phyag g.yog rags bsdus la tshe dbang dang*/ so so'i 'dod chos zhu ba shin tu mang zhing*/

rab gnas zhu mi mang ba dang*/ ja 'dren dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas pa sogs byung*/ thub pa gser gling ma spyan drangs phyag mchod smon lam rgyas pa phul/ sang nyin yang skya ser gyi skye bo dpag tu med pa 'dus pa la ma ṇi'i lung dang so sor dbang bka' rjes gnang mang dag dang bcas pa bsgrubs nas/ slar yang sne gdong rtser chos bka' 'phros 'phran bu yod pa rnams phul zhing*/ tshogs chen mo ba'i sa lugs pa rnams la bzhed pa ltar kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang cha gnyis pa zhig byas/ de nas tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin skyel ma'i tshogs shin tu mang pos gling kha'i bar du skyel ma mdzad/ de nub kyang rnam sras gling gi skyed tshal der bsdad 'dod chos than thun bshad cing*/ btsun gsar ma byed mi shin tu mang ba byung*/ sang nyin me long gdan sa pa rang 'bod par byung ba'i bzhin me long dgon par byin/ tshe dbang sogs chos than thun dang*/ grwa rigs thams cad la 'du khang der bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig chos 'brel du byas/ grwa thang gi thang du bla chen rin po che'i drung yang 'phrad par phebs byung zhing*/ gzhan yang mi tshogs che ba rang 'dug pas chos 'brel zhig byas/ de nub lhun grub lha rtser sleb/ chos rje sked srong pa la dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum dang phag mo gzhung drug gi lung byas gzhan yang chos than thun bshad/ dol mda'i gru thon nas lam bsrangs te lho ngos su dpon sa'i drung dang mjal/ glang thang gzims khang du yud tsam phyin/ lhun grub rdzong du stag lung nas sde pa'i drung dar yang mjal bslab ston than thun 'dra yang zhus/ sang nyin stag lung thang du sleb pa'i gzims spyil du bsdad cing*/ de'i gnangs nyin skyabs mchog dam pa rje btsun dpal stag lung pa chen po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs drung du mjal bar phyin/ de gong bar skabs su mgur cham 'khrugs pa glo tshad kyi rnam par song ba'i sku khams dub pa rang zhig byung 'dug pa sku rim sogs gnang ba'i sku khams bde mus kyi skabs na 'dug cing*/

de skabs kyang sku mtsham me ba 'dug pas nyin re bzhin nyung bsdus kyis zhal mjal zhus/ grog khar sku gdung sku gzhogs su dngos cag nyi shu skor gyis 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub mchod re btang*/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya rtsa/ lha dgu ma brgya rtsa 'chi blu'i cho ga dang bcas pa sku rim du bsgrubs shing*/ tshes bcu drug gi nyin dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi byung*/ 'di skabs chos khri thang du stag lung rang gi dgon pa bu cha lag dang bcas pa tshogs shing nyan po dang rin chen brag gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa yongs bsgril tshogs pa nyis stong tsam tshogs shing*/ dngos kyis sa khri dmar po'i steng du bsdad/ stag lung rang gi tshogs kyi bca' ba bcu gsum gyi rim pa dang 'brel bar mdzad/ dgongs rdzogs kyi dngos po gzhal bar dka' ba byung*/ dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i mchod bsngo rgyas par phul/ rtse nas sprul pa'i skur rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang dang*/ mi g.yo rnal 'byor bla med sogs dgongs bzhed ltar phul zhing*/ dngos kyis kyang lha lnga'i dbang sogs chos bka' mang dag zhus/ 'di skabs bdag po bkra shis stobs rgyas sku mi brtan pa'i ltas kyang gsal bar shes nas zla bo rnams la ma gsang par bshad/ slar yang rnam rgyal rab brtan tu zhabs drung rin po che cung zad sku khams zi ba'i stabs nas sku gzhogs su phyin/ sku shin tu dub pa'i rnam pa 'dug pas de nyin rang brtan bzhugs phul ba de 'phral rang nas sku khams bde ba'i rnam pa mngon par byang zhing*/ dge 'dun dam tshig gtsang ba rnams kyis bskang gso tshe gzungs sogs sku rim rgya cher sgrub pa'i bkod pa'ang bgyis/ sku tshe'i rten 'brel gyi dbang rjes gnang kyang nyin re bzhin phul/ 'di skabs mtshams bcad ma thub na'ang zhag shas bsnyen pa kha gso'i tshul du byas/ de mtshams bla mas bka' phebs pa bzhin sku rim du dmigs pa'i drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog sgrub pa'i sngags thun gsung mi 'chag dang bcas pa blos longs par bgyis shing*/

gtor ma 'phangs pa'i tshe dmigs pa gsal zhing phyi rlung ltas la sogs pa yang legs par byung*/ de nub pha rol gyi dmag sde bcom pa sogs rmi lam gyi ltas kyang bzang*/ nang bar bka' phebs la mdang gtor ma mar khyer song ba tsam la sku khams kyang yang chod chod 'gro ba'i rnam pa gsal khyad thon pa byung zhing*/ nub mo gnyid kyang shin tu bde ba rang byung*/ da khams dga' mo yong ba 'dug phebs kyi 'dug pa bzhin thog tu khel/ de nas kyang zhag shas kyi bar du dbang chos 'dra phul/ spyir sku gzhogs su rgyang tsam bsdad na dgongs pa'ang 'dug cing*/ dngos kyang bla ma'i sku drung rang du sdod pa la yid dang spro bar yod na'ang*/ sne gdong rtser sdod dus ngam ring nas 'bod mir gser khang pa tshe ring 'byor pa 'di skabs kyang rkang btsugs su bsdad yod pas/ kho bas dgos med kyi skul cag spro thung rang byed pas de kha'i stabs nas bka' phebs la yang da lam gang myur 'gro ba las 'os med phebs shing*/ de mthun gyi hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu dgu la sku gzhogs nas thon pa'i lhag par yang bla ma kho na yid la byed bzhin pas nyin dang mtshan du 'da' bar gyur to/ / 'dir smras pa/ da lta'i smra dbang 'bum phrag brgya dag kyang*/ / gang gis mdun sar mi smra'i brtul zhugs can/ / rang la ma chags tshig gi bdud grol ba/ / brjod bral lam du 'jug 'di ngo mtshar rmado/ / de nas de nyin dog sar 'phos glang thang du zhag gsum pa zhig bsdad/ kyai rdor gyi dbang zhig kyang byas/ slar 'phan yul gyi gzhung bskor te glang rar zhag gcig dang*/ de nas lho ngos su phyin tshe dbang sogs chos than thun phul/ bdag po bkras stobs drung sku 'das pa'i gtam yang 'dir khyer byung*/ nang par ra sa 'phrul snang du sleb/ zhag shas phyag mchod sogs 'phel bar byung*/ zhal gser zhig kyang phul/ bar skor la dkon gnyer dpon gyis zhig gsos byed kyin 'dug pa rta gsum sogs zang zong mang dag zhig gsos kyi thes la btang*/

lha sa nas snga bar yongs te sbu ba gdong du skyid shod nas sde pa'i drung dang mjal tsam byas/ rim pas gzhis ka gong dkar du 'byor ba'i 'di skabs zhag nyi shu rtsa gsum bsdad cing*/ zhabs drung gdung brgyud rin po ches de gong bla med kyi dbang ma gsan pas da lam dbang bskur mang tsam zhig kyang dgos pa 'dug cing*/ khyad par dkon cing byin rlabs che bar 'dug pas rje btsun mar pa'i bzhed pa las 'byung ba ltar gyi dbang bskur rnams dgos phebs ba ltar/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje rtsa rgyud kyi yab bka' lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ yum bka' bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ bshad rgyud rdo rje gur nas 'byung ba rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor/ dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo lha lnga/ rnal 'byor nam mkha' lha dgu bcu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor/ drug po de rnams mar rngog gi phyag bzhes gtsang ma phyag len shin tu dag pa dang dbang bshad chun yang gzhan dang ma 'dres par bgyis/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang bskur ba rgya gzhung nyid kyi rjes su 'brang de bsgrubs/ skyid shongs nas rab gnas la yong dgos tshul nan chags byung ba ltar phyin zhing*/ sleb pa'i nyin mo nyid rab gnas nyin gcig ma'i cho ga bgyis/ sang nyin so sor dgongs bzhed kyi chos rnam grangs mang tsam phul zhing*/ sras mo zhig gis rab byung yang sgrub par mdzad/ slar yang gzhis kar chos kyi 'phro rnams phul/ lhun rab pa'i zhal ngo rnams btsan mdo'i mdun der 'phrad par phebs shing gang ci'i gzhis len sogs bzab ma rang mdzad/ dzaṃ la dmar po sogs rjes gnang 'ga' shas dang tshe dbang sogs byas/ 'brang phu dgon par sleb nas mi ngo rnams la yang tshe dbang sogs 'ga' zhig byas/ rang gi lhan cig gnas pa 'ga' la sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa'i rgyud rdzogs par bshad cing*/ chos rje grub thob pa yang skyed tshal 'og gi mkhan por phebs pa'i nged la 'phrad pa dang chos 'dra zhu ba la byon byung*/

lhun rab nas sde pa bla ma'i thugs 'dod ltar bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang dang*/ snying po don gsum gyi khrid sogs bzhed chos rnams byas/ de rjes su yol ba mkhan chen yang chos zhu bar ched kyis phebs byung ba/ bzhed don gyi gtso bo lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid yin 'dug pa bzhin/ phyag rgya chen po mchod rten drung thob kyi khrid de 'phral nas btsugs shing*/ sa 'dir zab pa'i tshul dgu lhan cig skyes grub/ gtum mo lam rdzogs/ yi ge med pa rnams grub cing*/ lhag ma rnams 'brog stag lung du byas pa yin/ yol mkhan chen dang nged rang gi lhan cig gnas pa dge bshes 'ga' shas la ma hā mā ya'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u gsum pa'i rgyud bshad zhib pa zhig kyang byas/ 'di skabs zla ba phyed gnyis tsam bsdad cing*/ de mtshams nas yar sris/ sna dkar rtse rnams brgyud nas yar 'brog stag lung du hor zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga la sleb/ tshe dbang rjes gnang sogs sleb 'phral nas dbu tshugs shing*/ sde pa khu dbon rang la tshes bco brgyad nas lam 'bras zhig kyang 'go tshugs/ 'di skabs khu dbon gnyis ma gtogs gzhan la mi byed pa'i rgyun mtshan yang myur du rdzogs par byed dgos byung ba'i dgag dgos kyi dbang las yin zhing*/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad la grol zla gcig zhag nyi shu tsam song*/ lam 'bras glegs bam man ngag phra mo po ti yongs rdzogs/ lam skor phyi ma dang bcas pa rnams song*/ man ngag lugs kyi rgyud dbang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten de dbang cha gnyis tsam zhig kyang bgyis/ khu dbon drung rang du lus dkyil yab bka' yum bka' gnyis/ lam zab phyi nang gnyis/ bir bsrung phyi nang la sogs pa lam 'bras kyi byin rlabs rnams kyang cha tshang bar phul/ zhal ngo rtse rgyas dang*/ gzhan yang gzhi byes kyi don gnyer so so dang bcas pa la man ngag lugs kyi bdag med ma/ kyai rdor ḍombi lugs/

mtsho skyes lugs/ nag po lugs la he ru ka bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbang ste bka' babs lhag ma de rnams ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten te bgyis/ zhal ngo thams cad dang don gnyer mang dag la phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i khrid shin tu smin pa zla chos shig bgyis shing*/ zhal ngo mna' rnyid sogs la bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang zhig byas pas/ sta gon gyi skabs su srin lag nas khrag dang brdol ting chung zhig khengs pa tsam byung*/ dbang mi drug cu tsam la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs rdzogs shig kyang bgyis/ sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te/ zhal ngo bzhi sogs dbang mi dgu tsam la dbang nyin bdun ma'i phyag len rdzogs pa dang rgyud kyi lung yang bgyis/ zhal ngo rnams la rnam rgyal lha mang*/ gza' yum nor rgyun ma ste dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dbang yang phul/

gnas bcu'i zhal thang chen mo gsar bzhengs la rab gnas byas pas gnas brtan lam phran brtan dang*/ rgyal chen mig mi bzang gis me tog bzhes/ gzhan yang rang re'i gra slob 'ga' shas la dza landha ra'i do ha'i man ngag rgyas pa tshar gnyis dang*/ mig g.yo bla na med kyi khrid sogs dang*/ snga sor hor zla gnyis pa'i 'go rang nas bka' babs bdun ldan gyi man ngag bshad pa'i 'go brtsams pa skabs 'dir mthar phyin pa tsam byung*/ de nas re zhig de phyogs kyi brel ba chod pa'i lugs su byas te/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gcig la lam du zhugs/ gnam grur sleb skabs rgya gar kyi kla klo'i chos lugs 'dzin pa dar bhe sha gcig dang 'phrad sems ma dga' se ba zhig byung*/ phugs rgyal rtser mi legs pa'i rten 'brel du 'dugarim pas brgyud de rgyal rtser 'byor/ thog mar rkyen sel gyi dbang chos 'dra phul zhing so so'i bzhed ltar bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang*/ 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor/ mi g.yo ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dbang*/ bdag po rgyal ba'i drung dang smar khrid dang phyag chen ga'u ma/ zhal ngo spyi khyab tu spros med kyi khrid sogs chos kyi rim pa rnams 'phel bar byung zhing*/ bar skabs der 'brong rtse brgyud nas 'dol byung la phyin pa/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po dang gshin rje gshed gdong drug gi dbang bskur/ gzhan yang dgongs bzhed kyi chos sna mang du bgyis/ lha sdings su sngar yang yang 'gro ba bzhin 'di res kyang phyin/ dbon chen lhun grub bzang po rang gis mo la btang*/ da thod pa nam 'bogs cha mi 'dug pas shi ba byung na dgon chung 'di la'ang thugs rjes gzigs zer/ mnga' bdag rgyas mo'i sku gdung zhugs 'bul byed dgos stabs slar rgyal rtser phyin/ gam pa nas bdag po'i drung yang phebs 'dug pa tshe dbang brgya tshar dang*/

bde mchog nag po ba'i dbang zhig kyang phul/ tshes bdun gyi dgongs mo rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga la brten te gdung 'od bzhu byas zhugs 'bul shin tu legs shing dbu thog ril por byon pa'i rnam pa byung*/ dpon sa yid lags drung dpon g.yog bcu skor la nai gu'i mgyogs khrid sgyu lus dbang mo che dang bcas pa dgongs bzhes ltar phul/ de nas rtse chen du phyin zhag shas 'gor/ dgongs bzhed kyi chos 'dra phul/ rang res stag lo chos sde'i khur bzhag pa de phyin chad chos sder ci yang ma phyin pas 'di skabs 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i dngul gdung la byin rlabs zhu bar phyin/ rang gnas bsam gtan sdings su sleb/ sgrub sde ba rnams la nai gu 'bring po zhig bshad cing*/ 'jag nas rin po che sprul sku dpon slob rnams dang sman thang blo bzang pa yang 'phrad par byon byung*/ thugs dgongs ltar gyi chos 'dra byas/ gser mdog can nas shangs ba slob dpon pa chos khrims dang bcas pa nged yong dgos tshul la phebs byung zhing ma hā mā ya'i dbang bskur zhig kyang bzhed pa ltar byas/ skabs 'dir bsam sdings su zla phyed tsam song*/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gsum la spa mnam rdzong du 'ongs/ nang par rje grub thob karma pa dgu pa yang phebs pa'i sku gzhogs mjal bar phyin zhag bzhi'i bar du nyin re bzhin mjal ba'i chos 'brel gyi thog mar sku gsum ngo sprod chos thun gcig la 'dus pazhig gnang zhing*/ sngon grub thob pa gshis kyang o rgyan pa la chos thams cad kyi don brgyud gtad pa'i chos 'brel dngos su stsal ba ni 'di kho na yin 'di gsan pas karma kam tshang gi chos thams cad don gyis gsan pa yin no gsung*/ gzhan yang lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid thun gcig la tshang ba zhig dang*/ sgrub thabs zab pa 'ga' shas dang*/ tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ rtsa gsum dril sgrub/

rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang*/ ber nag can gyi gtor dbang bla ma'i rnal 'byor thugs la shar ba gcig sogs dgyes bzhin du stsal/ snga phyir thugs su byon pa'i bka' lung bag phebs par gnang*/ de mtshams tshong 'dus su phyin pa'i zhag bdun bsdad cing*/ 'di skabs rje karma pa dbang phyug rdo rjes dngos la bstod pa brtan bzhugs smon lam shlau ka gsum pa zhig ched gtad skyel bar gnang byung*/ dge bshes nor bu dpal bzang pa la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs pad ma dra ba'i dbang bskur zhig kyang byas/ so so'i 'dod pa dang bstun pa'i chos gzhan yang mang du bgyis/ de nas dkar po la la brgyud nas chos grwa chen po gser mdog can du phyaugs/ la rtsa nas mkhan slob rnams kyang bsu ba la phebs/ dge 'dun rnams kyi ser bsgrengs bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te 'byor/ bkra shis brtsegs pa mkhan slob sogs rags bsdus la 'khor lo bde mchog sdom 'byung lha bcu gsum ma dang*/ sgrol ma bla med ma'i dbang zhig byas/ shangs pa grwa tshang du yang mkhan slob sogs drag bsdus la 'khor lo bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dbang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dbang*/ rjes gnang 'ga' zhig rnams bgyis/ tshogs chen la rjes gnang zur bka' nyi shu tsam dang*/ gsang 'dus rim lnga 'gos lugs kyi khrid/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar zhib mo rnam dag gi chos 'khor yan chad tsam gyi lung sogs dang*/ mkhan slob rnams la rim lnga mar lugs kyi khrid yongs rdzogs dang*/ spyod bsdus sgron me'i lung sogs phul/ 'di skabs rtse chen nas dpon sa'i drung shin tu bsnyung ba'i 'phral sleb dgos tshul phebs byung na'ang*/ sku khams skyon mi yong ba'i khag thegad lam mi yong zhus nas ma phyin/ 'bod mi yid ma ches byed kyin 'dug na'ang phyis de ka ltar byung*/ de nas bsam grub rtser sde pa sku gzhon pa'i drung dang*/ sras yum rnams su dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang bskur ba dang*/

dkyil 'khor de nyid la brten te zhal thang 'ga' zhig la rab gnas kyang bgyis shing dga' ston tshogs 'khor kyang dpe med byung*/ 'di skabs rab gnas kyi seng bar la dkar me zhig dar yol la mched/ rnam pa gcig tsam tshigartog pa za bar byung*/ yon bdag tshor thugs rtog byung dogs dar de ka 'dra bas spos pas sus kyang ma rigagazhan yang tshe bka' sogs dgongs bzhed ltar phul nas/ dpal snar thang du zhag lnga tsam bsdad pa'i yab yum so sor chos than thun dang*/ sde pa'i drung du slob dpon sa dyā na tha nas brgyud pa'i he ru ka'i byin rlabs shig kyang dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ chos kyi gsung gleng 'phel bar byung*/ chu mig gi sgrol ma dang byams pa sogs rten rnams la phyag mchod rgyas par byas/ byang chen du 'byor pa'i dgon pa byang du khrom dbang zhig byas pa mi tshogs kyang che/ sgrub sde rnams la skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang smar khrid zhig bshad/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa jo bo lugs kyi dbang bskur zhig kyang byas shing*/ de gnyis kyi cho ga 'dzugs pa'i bkod pa'ang de dus byas pas myur stabs tshugs/ de nas rim pas lam bsrangs stag la'i la thog nas thal rlung chen po rang gcig byung*/ re shig stod phyogs ma 'gro zer ba'i brdar 'dugari khrod chen po jo mo nang du 'byor ma thag dpon sa rgyal drung gis ja 'dren bzab ma zhig byung*/ gzhan ni gang yang med byang gi spyan 'dren pa ni ldogade'i sang nyin rang nas dus khrid zhig kyang btsugs/ 'di skabs gtam gsar pa'i snga ltas shig dang rmi lam gyi 'char sgo gsal ba 'dra byung bas/ rgyun sdod kyi zla bo thams cad la gtam gsan chen po zhig yong ba 'dug smras pa ltar/ de 'phral rje dbang phyug rdo rje zhing rjes song*/ sngon 'gro'i ring la sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang byas/ khrid 'dzugs pa 'phyis pa'i stabs khrid gsar pa mi nag pa'i rigs mang po ma byung na'ang*/

khrid gsar pa grwa pa byis pa 'dra dang btsun gsar ma rang lnga bcu tsam yang byung zhing*/ gzhan yang las dang po rnams dang bcas pas dam po 'debs mkhan mang rab byung*/ sngar khyud kyi phyag len ltar dus chos shin tu smin par byas/ sngon 'gro'i skabs shig rmi lam du slob dpon padma yin zer ba'i sku'i rnam pa shin tu gsal ba zhig dang*/ de la gus pas bstod pa zhig kyang byas pa sad nas ma brjed par yi ger bris/ de nyin gu ru'i sku 'dra zhig kyang ster mkhan byung*/ yang rgyal ba mi phams pa babs pa yin zer nas chos ci yang zhig bshad kyin 'dugaganyid sad tsa na gzhan mi dran sher snying dngos po brgyad dang sbyar nas bshad pa de blo la ram me 'dugaphyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i gtam la snying thag pa nas nges shes lhang nger shar/ kun mkhyen rton pa bzhi ldan chen po'i byin rlabs kyi 'jug sgo yin par mngon/ khrid grol nas zla phyed tsam mtshams dam par bcad/ de mtshams bsam 'grub rtse nas dpon sa'i drung chab tshan gyi zhor la mtshed du mjal ba dang*/ de mthun jo nang du yang phebs pa'i rten mjal sogs zhib mor gnang*/ sgrub sder nas khal lnga brgya gnang*/ de rjes su yang zla gcig tsam mtshams dam par byas/ de yang de gong phag byi glang gsum gyi lo la nyams kyi rtsal chu ltar 'khrug pa thun mong gi yon tan mang po skye skye 'dra ba yod/ stag lo yang de'i rgyud phyogs 'dra tsam byung*/ yos lo 'di nas de yang rim pas yal zhun mar rtseg chod pa na khol mi yong ba dang 'dra ba nyams sangs nas rtogs pa nyag gcig mnyam nyid du song snyam pa'i dga' dga' 'dra mo zhig snang na'ang phugs ni lo gong ma gsum bzhi de la 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis dbang du song nyams kyi rtsal phyogs med du sbyong ba ma byung bas dus la bab pa'i rten 'brel las yol dge sbyor la bogs ma thon pa kho na'i skyon du snang*/ 'dis rang don dang gzhan don gnyis ka la skyon chen po zhugs te/

re shig brjod pa'i gnas med do/ / de skabs gting skyes nas sde pa ma chen drung sku khams kyang ltems yun ring ba dang*/ sku zhud sogs sku dog gi rnam pa che ba 'dug pas 'phral sleb dgos tshul byung ba/ de mtshams chos lung byang rtser khor tsam phyin chu ser gyis pus mo na ba la phan du re ba'i chu tshan zhag lnga tsam bsten/ sgrub sde rnams la rtsa dbu ma'i khrid cig bshad cing dbang rjais gnang 'ga' bsgrubs/ nged dbus na yod dus ngam ring nas mi sna gnang ba'i rten sgam zhal 'byed lan gnyis tsam mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu gcig kyang ma lus 'dugagrwa pa rnams kyang rten mjal ma myong ba sha stag yin pas rten sgam zhal 'byed byas pas sngar gyi sa na med pa gnyis gsum zhig snang*/ nged rang dol du mtshams bcad skabs mkha' 'gros stsal ba'i sman mchog dbang po'i 'bras bu de yang*/ snga phyi'i rten 'brel 'ga' la rten sgam du bzhugs su gsol/ de nas gtsang mgo gnyis mar tshe dbang rjes gnang gang 'os dang*/ gzungs grwa lnga'i dbang zhig dang khrom dbang zhig kyang byas shing*/ nyin gcig bde mchog rtser phyin pa'i bka' brgyad lha khang la rab gnas dang tshogs khang du bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig kyang byas/ de nas yar lam dgon pa 'bras spungs kyi mdun der/ 'bras spungs gdan sa pa shāka mchog pa'i drung dang dge 'dun rnams dngos la 'phrad par phebs byung*/ de nub khyung dkar zhol du sleb/ sang zhogs lha rtse rdzong dbon gnyis rang la tshe dbang zhig dgos zer ba byas dus nyi ma gza' 'dzin byung ba'i mun shin tu nag par song ba phyis dam sel chen por 'gro ba'i rten 'brel du snang*/ de nas bde gling du sleb/ gnas pa bcu'i zhal thang gsar bzhengs la rab gnas byas/ rim pas mkhar chen du 'byor zhing*/ sde pa rin po che'i drung yang sku khams yar sor byung 'dugamo lon sogs cung zad rtsub ba la brten pa'i dgongs bzhed ltar sde pa ma chen sku rkyang du tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya tshar gnyis dang*/

dze ta ri'i lugs brgya tshar/ dpal mgon po'i rjes gnang tshar lnga bcas/ sleb nas mi ring bar mchod yon lhan rgyas kyi khul nas brag stod du rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa spyan 'dren du btang*/ zhang 'brug sgra'i sgrub gnas gdong khra blta bar phyin/ de na dgra nag gi dkyil thang rgya gar ma yin nges ri mo legs nyes 'bring tsam la chud zos shin tu che bas mngon mi mngon tsam du song ba zhig 'dugade la bltas dus la li ta'i gshin rje gshed 'byung ba'i dgongs pa zhang lugs pa rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i rnam gzhag la nges shes skye bar byung*/ bar 'dir cham pa shin tu na bas zhag gnyis tsam chos mtshams byas/ de nas don gnyer so sor bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang*/ 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi khrid dang*/ nai gu'i khrid rkyang zhig dang*/ mi g.yo bla med kyi dbang*/ zhal ngo rnams la gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang*/ drag po'i rjes gnang mang dag dang bcas pa so so sgos kyi 'dod chos thang thung rnam grangs sna tshogs dang*/ khrom dbang sems bskyed dang bcas pa zhig kyang bgyis/ rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'ang spyan 'dren zhus pa ltar hor zla bzhi pa'i nyer lnga la mkhar chen du zhabs zung 'god pa gnang*/ yid kyi gdung ba thams cad dbyings su thim thugs yid dbyer med brjod bral mkha' mnyam khyab bdag chen po'i rang zhal lta ba ni nam yang yong mod kyi mdor na sku rnam pa thams cad pa ye shes kyi rang snang rgyal ba kun gyi sku'i rdo rje dang*/ gsung gzhom med sgra skad thams cad pa sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi rang bzhin mig dang rna ba'i bdud rtsir gyur pa nyid kyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub gzhan la gus pa dbyings su yal te 'di nyid kho na bdag dang 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i gtan gyi nyer 'tsho'o/

/ zhes pa 'di 'ba' zhig yid la byed pa dang nyin dang mtshan du nang gi dga' ba dang bde bas khyab par gyur to/ / skabs 'dir gsung gi bdud rtsi thob pa'i rim pa ni/ gling gi bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs bdag nyid kyis myur bar bklags te 'phar lung du zhus/ ro snyoms chen mo yongs su rdzogs pa'ang thob/ gtso bor bdag nyid kyis ji ltar mngon du bgyis pa las brtsams te/ nyin re bzhin du yang yang du zhus pa de dang de'i 'phrang sgrol ba dang gong nas gong du khyad par du bogs dbyung ba'i bka' drin stsal ba ni bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig yod do/ / 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa bcu gcig pa sbyar ro/ / de nas dngos la bla ma dam pas rten 'brel gyi gnad yod ces phebs nas brtan bzhugs shig kyang gnang*/ tshe dbang brgya tshar gyi bka' drin yang stsal zhing*/ da lam chos thams cad kyi don gyi dbang bskur thob pa'i dbang dgongs pas bcad pa zhig gnang dgos zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog slob dpon spyod pa pa'i bzhed srol ltar dbang bzhi rdzogs pa dang*/ de nyid kyi mthar bdag phyogs kyi gos can phyag rgya drug la sogs pa'i he ru ka'i chas rnam par bkod de/

spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyi rjes su gnang ba shin tu rgyas par stsal/ rigs kyi bdag po nyid kyis bdag la rab gnas kyi me tog kyang mthor bar gnang*/ bdag po dang bdag po chen po'i dbang gi don yang 'di la 'doms par 'dug ga ṇa tsa kra'i dga' ston yang nyams su myong ste/ e ma ho/ da ni khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen pos ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i rgyud las ji skad gsungs pa lta bu'i rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyang ci'i phyir spyod par mi nus zhes dbugs phyung*/ rnam pa brgya phrag du mas mngon par mtho ba'i gzings bstod par yang gyur to/ / 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa bcu gnyis pa sbyor ro/ / bcu gnyis po 'di dag bod sgom rnams kyi gsung ltar na nyams yin kyang 'dra/ rtogs pa yin kyang 'dra/ gang yin kyang khyad med/ 'char sgo de dang de 'dra gcig ni byung ba lags so/ / smras pa/ sngar ma shes rnams ci yang go / go ba tsam yin na'ang yin du chug/ myong yang myong bya dang myong byed stor/ / 'di ma shar bya ba gcig kyang med/ / nyams yin zhes gsung na'ang gsung bar zhu/ / rang bzhin la 'gyur ba med par rtogs/ / rtogs pa la yid du re ba med/ / yin zer na'ang 'gal ba mi 'dug go / sa bcu gnyis dag pa'i gnas pa 'di/ / nga sgyu ma'i skyes bus thob par 'dod/ / don thob bya thob byed dbyings su yal/ / tshig smra brjod bral ba a la la/ / 'jig rten 'di ni spros pa'i rjes su 'jug/ gzhan dag spros bral tshig gis mtshon par 'dod/ / spros dang spros med ro mnyam gyur pa dag/ don dam gnas na ci bder gnas zhes thos/ / de nas dpal ldan bla ma dam par dka' drin rjes su dran pa'i yon mtshon byed tsam phul te/ brtan bzhugs rgyas pa'i sgo nas zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba btab bo/ / snga sor stag lo'i nang du sku khams bsnyel ba'i tshul bstan pa de 'di'i bar du 'phro lus pa'i rnam pa phyag yul cung zad mi bde ba dang sku khams kyang bying pa'i rnam pa 'dug phebs pa zhig yod na'ang*/

brtan bzhugs phul ba 'di las brtsams te sku khams shin tu dwangs shing sku gzugs shin tu bzang ba rang du gyur pa 'dis kyang mos pa'i dge ba rnam par dag pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa brtan pa yin no/ / 'di skabs bzang ldan chos sde nas slob dpon bkra shis dbang phyug pa dang byang nas mi sna bde gling nang so gzi 'bar ba byung*/ bzang ldan du tshes bzhi la lam 'bras tshugs nges dgos tshul du 'dug cing*/ de ni don la'ang dgos par yod mod kyi/ thams cad dus thug cing dog sar 'dzom pa'i 'gag thug sar brla bsgrad pa'i dpe/ de'i sngon du ngam ring du khor tsam ma 'byor na gtan mi rung ba'i nan chags dang*/ gdong 'ga' nas kyang 'bor mi car sdod zhag shas sdod dgos kyi nan chags sogs zhe sun po rang cig byung bas/ 'di gong gam pa la 'gro ba'i khas len yod kyang bshol/ bla ma dam pa'i sku mtshams 'og tu nyin re bzhin zhal dkyil mjal bar phyin cing*/ sde pa zhal ngo rnams su rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs shig dgos phebs byung na'ang*/ da lam 'jug gi rten 'brel yin pas phag dkar shes rab gsal byed zhig 'gyur rnying pa'i lugs byed byas de phul/ tshes bcu dgu la chas de nub chu babs su sgyogs mkhan pa tshang gi der bsdad/ de nyin lam gyi ngal dub shin tu che ba zhig byung ste phyin na mi legs zer rgyur 'dugade nub kyi tho rangs snga zur tsam la gting skyes nas 'dren dpon tshe ring sleb pa'i sde pa ma chen drung kha sang dgongs phyogs nas sku bsnyel ba'i sku khams thu bar byung bas 'phral du ldog yong dgos tshul du 'dug pa/ rlung ltas sogs 'phral gyi ltas la brtags pas nyes skyon gcig kyang mi 'dug pas/ de phyin bzang ldan gyi chos 'di yang phyis 'grub dka' zhing dge 'dun gyi bya ba bshol du mi rung bar 'dug snyam pas da lam skyon mi yong ba khag theg pas yong mi dgos par 'dug byas zhu lan yang de 'phral phul/

rim pas gdong dgar sleb/ zhag bdun sdod dgos byung zhing*/ skyes rabs so bzhi mdzad bcu gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyi zhal thang gsar bzhengs rnams la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs su gsol te/ rab gnas nyin gsum pa'i cho gas bgyis pa dang stabs bstun du dbang bskur zhig kyang byas/ gzhan yang tshe dbang brgya tshar dang*/ 'jam dpal smra seng dang*/ zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang sogs brjed chos 'ga' shas dang*/ gdong dga' slob dpon pa dang rags rdzong slob dpon pa gnyis la nag po rim bzhi'i khrid zhig kyang bshad/ gnas rnying rje drung ye shes rgya mtsho pa yang chos zhu ba la 'di skabs nas phebs byung zhing rim pas ngam ring du sleb/ de nyid dpal ldan sdings su zhabs drung lcam sring phebs 'dugabasam 'grub dga' ldan pa dang*/ rtser bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams gyis ser bsgrengs dang bcas bsu ba gzab ma gnang*/ 'di skabs zhag gsum bsdad pa la zhal ngo spyir tshe dbang brgya tshar dang drag po'i rjes gnang 'ga' zhig phul/ gzhan so sor 'dod chos thang thung 'dra bshad/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin ngam ring nas snga bar chas te/ dpal bzang ldan gyi lung pa'i phu'i mtsho kha der/ che bgres slob dpon rnams kyang bsu ba la phebs shing*/ dge 'dun rnams kyi ser bsgrengs kyi bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas bzang ldan chos sde chen por sleb/ de nyin 'jam dbyangs chos khri'i steng nas dge 'dun rnams la byin rlabs tsam zhig byas/ de'i sang nyin bod spyi'i 'dod pa la bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi dus chen yin zer ba la/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag gi byung khungs sogs bshad dbu tshugs par byas/ / tshes lnga nas brtsams te snga chos dgongs chos kyi chos thun gnyis gnyis thun shin tu che bar bshad cing*/ snang gsum skabs tshogs pa ngos ma stong rwa can tsam dang*/

zhor nyan pa nyis brgya skor byung zhing*/ rgyu dbang dbang cha bzhi bcu rgal nges pa dang*/ rgyud gsum man chad sna tshogs pa ngos ma drug brgya mi chad pa/ lam dbang dbang cha nyer lnga tsam byung zhing snang gsum gyi skabs khrid dmigs gang nges dang bshad pa'ang mtha' chod par bgyis/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba dang*/ rje btsun grol mchog gi rnam thar rgyas pa'i lung tsam zhig song*/ tshes lnga de nyid nas brtsams te gnas rnying rje drung sogs la gung seng la shangs chos skor rnams bgyis shing*/ zla ba de nyid kyi tshes bcu gcig nas brtsams te/ snga chos dgongs chos kyi bar dang dbang gi seng sogs kyi nyin gung la tshogs pa rags bsdus brgya skor la lam skor phyi ma rnams bshad cing*/ snga gro re bzhin tshogs pa gang yod kyi steng du nye skor gyi yon bdag 'dra dang bcas pa la rjes gnang zur bka' gnyis tsam re 'chags med du bgyis/ 'dir de ltar chos bshad pa'i rim pa mdo tsam ni gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag smin rgyas/ lta ba bskyed rdzogs rnams mdo rgyud spyi sgos kyi bshad pa mtha' chod pa dang*/ lam 'bras rang rkang gi chos skad thun mong ma yin pa rnams zhib mo 'thems nan dang*/ dmigs pa rnams la bskyar chos kyi sgo nas shin tu nges par byas/ iṇḍa bhu ti'i lam skor ma gtogs/ lam skor phyi ma rnams kyi dmigs khrid nges can dang*/ so so'i go babs kyi bshad pa rnams kyang gcig la gcig rgyas 'gebs kyi rang bzor ma song ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rang skad kho na'i sgo nas mtha' chod cing sgom don la 'dro lo bar byas/ sems bskyed kyi skabs mchod pa'i bkod pa yang shin tu rgyas pa dang*/ zhu mkhan yang stong phrag gnyis lhag nges pa byung*/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dbang dang*/ rje btsun bdag med ma'i lus dkyil byin rlabs rgyas pa lam zab phyi nang*/

bir bsrungs phyi nang*/ sangs rgyas spyan ma'i bzlas lung*/ aṣta'i bzlas lung*/ yig brgya'i bzlas lung*/ bla ma rin 'byung*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshar gsum khug pa/ bla ma don grub kyi tshar gsum khug pa/ dbang bzhi ngo sprod/ brda' don gsal ba/ mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang*/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs/ sgrub pa lung 'byin gyi bar du byin rlabs kyi rim pa yang mtha' rgyas dang*/ de bzhin du bsam mi khyab kyi byin rlabs/ phyag chen yi ge med pa'i byin rlabs/ rags bsdus la nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs cha drug/ mai tri mkha' spyod dang ind+ra mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs tshar re/ dmar po skor gsum gyi rje gnang*/ bde mchog nag po pa dang*/ 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor dbang cha re re/ shangs chos pa rnams la sgyu lus dbang mo che/ ga'u ma'i bka' che chung gnyis mkha' spyod bka' lnga/ 'chi med 'khrul 'khor gyi byin rlabs sogs dang*/ gser chos lnga'i khrid/ 'chi med 'khrul 'khor gyi lag len/ lung chos skor po ti gnyis song*/ tshogs chen du byin rlabs dang rjes gnang gi rim pa/ bde mchog lhan skyes dang kyai rdor lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs/ bka' gdams lha bzhi so so'i rjes gnang*/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro/ rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drugami g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa/ mi g.yo ba zhabs bzhi pa/ mi g.yo spre'u brgyad ma/ o rgyan sgrol ma/ spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin nor bu sogs zur bka' brgyad cu lhag pa dang*/ de dag la brten pa'i yig lung ci rigs pa dang bcas pa/ don gnyer 'ga' zhig la bya ba spyi rgyud gsum dang*/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud gzhung 'ga' shas dang*/ khyad par gsang 'dus rim lnga la 'bru bshad mtha' gcod rgyas pa dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang dge 'dun nyis brgya tsam la ras chung lugs kyi tshe khrid sogs mdor na nyin mtshan du chos bshad kyis dus 'da' bar song*/

gong du chos tshugs ston rang la gshin don gyi mang ja zhig byung ba la rtog pa cung zad za ba zhig byung ba ltar rgyud gsum gyi 'go tshugs tsam na/ sprang bo mang po nad kyis shi ba'i rkyen gyis grwa ba gsum bzhi la nad des gos/ de mtshams ri khrod ma'i rjes gnang sogs bgyis pas de phyin chad dgon khong du mched pa gcig kyang ma byung*/ 'di skabs phyogs mtha' thams cad na nad zla mang ba rang 'dug na'ang*/ bzang ldan rang du chos shin tu 'phel ba'i ngos nas/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu la lam 'bras kyang grol/ de skabs ngam ring nas gsung phebs de na nad rims yod 'dug pas zhag bcu skor de khar sdod pa dang*/ de nas bags bsang ba sogs la shug khrod du nges par 'gro dgos tshul dang*/ de mtshams ngam ring du yong dgos phebs byung bas de skabs zer tshad nyan pa'i spre'u'i khung rang byas/ bzang ldan rang du mtshams zhag bdun ma zhig dang*/ de grol nas shugs khrod du zhag brgyad bsdad cing*/ sgrub sde rnams la bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang zhig byas/ hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig la ngam rings su sleb/ de'i sang nyin rang nas chos kyi rim pa rnams tshugs shing*/ hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i bar du/ gtso bor zhabs drung nyid dang*/ gzhan yang gang 'os kyi don gnyer so so dang bcas pa rnams la so sor/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ma hā mā ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ sa lugs ro langs brgyad bskor/ zhe dgu ma/ skyo lugs drag po'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ bde mchog nag po pa/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ mi ga yo bla med de bla med kyi dkyil chen bcu dang*/ gzungs grwa lnga dang*/ tshe dpag med lha dgu ste bya rgyud kyi gnyis/ gri gug lha lnga/ gur lha bcu gnyis ma/ gyi ljang lha bcu bdun ma ste mgon po'i dbang bskur gsum/ yongs bsgril dbang bskur bco lnga byas/
